creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the PIDs cgroup limit is used
detail_zh: 确保使用PID的cgroup限制,

extraDetail.description: 你不应该使用Docker的默认桥docker0。相反，您应该使用Docker的用户定义网络进行容器联网。
extraDetail.rationale: Docker将以网桥模式创建的虚拟接口连接到一个名为docker0的公共网桥。这种默认的组网模式由于没有应用过滤，很容易受到ARP欺骗和MAC泛洪攻击。
extraDetail.audit:
运行下面的命令:
docker network ls --quiet | xargs docker network inspect --format '{{ .Name}}: {{ .Options }}'
并确保PidsLimit没有设置为0或-1。PidsLimit为0或-1意味着可以在容器内并发地fork任意数量的进程。
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该按照Docker文档设置用户定义的网络。所有的容器都应该在这个网络中运行。
extraDetail.impact: 用户自定义网络需要根据组织安全策略进行配置和管理。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker在默认的docker0桥中运行容器。
extraDetail.description_en: You should use the --pids-limit flag at container runtime.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Attackers could launch a fork bomb with a single command inside the container. This fork bomb could crash the entire system and would require a restart of the host to make the system functional again. Using the PIDs cgroup parameter --pids-limit would prevent this kind of attack by restricting the number of forks that can happen inside a container within a specified time frame.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below and ensure that PidsLimit is not set to 0 or -1. A PidsLimit of 0 or -1 means that any number of processes can be forked concurrently inside the container. docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: PidsLimit={{ .HostConfig.PidsLimit }}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: Use --pids-limit flag with an appropriate value when launching the container. For example: docker run -it --pids-limit 100 <Image ID> In the above example, the number of processes allowed to run at any given time is set to 100. After a limit of 100 concurrently running processes is reached, Docker would restrict any new process creation.
extraDetail.impact_en: Set the PIDs limit value as appropriate. Incorrect values might leave containers unusable.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: The Default value for --pids-limit is 0 which means there is no restriction on the number of forks. Note that the PIDs cgroup limit works only for kernel versions 4.3 and higher.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that management plane traffic is separated from data plane traffic
detail_zh: 确保管理平面流量与数据平面流量分开,

extraDetail.description: 应该将管理plane流量与数据plane流量分开。
extraDetail.rationale: 将management plane流量与data plane流量分离可以确保这两种类型的流量相互隔离。这些流量可以被单独监控，并与不同的流量控制策略和监控相关联。这也确保了即使data plane上有大量的通信，management plane也总是可达的。
extraDetail.audit:
请在每个集群节点上执行以下命令: 
docker node inspect  --format '{{ .Status.Addr }}' self
并确保management plane地址和data plane地址不相同。
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该分别使用management plane和data plane的专用接口初始化群集。
extraDetail.impact: 这需要每个节点有两个网络接口。
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，data plane流量与management plane流量不分离。
extraDetail.description_en: You should separate management plane traffic from data plane traffic.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Separating management plane traffic from data plane traffic ensures that these types of traffic are segregated from each other. These traffic flows can then be individually monitored and tied to different traffic control policies and monitoring. This also ensures that the management plane is always reachable even if there is a great deal of traffic on the data plane.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below on each swarm node and ensure that the management plane address is different from the data plane address. docker node inspect  --format '{{ .Status.Addr }}' self
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should initialize the swarm with dedicated interfaces for management and data planes respectively. For example, docker swarm init --advertise-addr=192.168.0.1 --data-path-addr=17.1.0.3
extraDetail.impact_en: This requires two network interfaces per node.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, data plane traffic is not separated from management plane traffic.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the /etc/docker directory ownership is set to root:root
detail_zh: 确保将/ etc / docker目录所有权设置为root：root,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证/etc/docker目录所有权和组所有权是否正确设置为root。
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/docker目录包含证书和密钥，以及其他各种敏感文件。因此，它应该是根用户拥有的个人和组，以确保它不能被特权较低的用户修改。
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令: 
stat -c %U:%G /etc/docker | grep -v root:root
并验证目录和组是否为root所拥有.
extraDetail.remediation:
要解决这个问题，您应该运行以下命令:
chown root:root /etc/docker
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，该目录的所有权和组所有权被正确设置为root。
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the /etc/docker directory ownership and group ownership is correctly set to root.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/docker directory contains certificates and keys in addition to various other sensitive files. It should therefore be individual owned and group owned by root in order to ensure that it can not be modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the directory is owned and group owned by root: stat -c %U:%G /etc/docker | grep -v root:root  This command should not return any data.
extraDetail.remediation_en: To resolve this issue you should run the following command: chown root:root /etc/docker This sets the ownership and group ownership for the directory to root.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the ownership and group ownership for this directory is correctly set to root.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the /etc/default/docker file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictively
detail_zh: 确保将/ etc / default / docker文件权限限制严格地设置为644或更高,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证/etc/default/docker文件权限是否正确设置为644或更严格
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/default/docker文件包含可能改变Docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该只能由根用户写，以确保它不会被特权较低的用户修改
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令: 
stat -c %a /etc/default/docker
来验证文件权限是否被正确设置为644或更严格
extraDetail.remediation:
要解决这个问题，您应该运行以下命令:
chmod 644 /etc/default/docker
extraDetail.defaultValue: 此文件可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用。
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the /etc/default/docker file permissions are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/default/docker file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the Docker daemon. It should therefore be writeable only by root in order to ensure that it is not modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the file permissions are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively: stat -c %a /etc/default/docker
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chmod 644 /etc/default/docker This sets the file permissions for this file to 644.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system and in this case, this recommendation is not applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that privileged containers are not used
detail_zh: 确保不使用特权容器,

extraDetail.description: 使用——privilege标志为它所应用的容器提供了所有Linux内核功能，因此会覆盖——cap-add和——cap-drop标志。出于这个原因，你应该确保它没有被使用
extraDetail.rationale: 特权标志为它所应用的容器提供了所有的功能，同时也解除了设备cgroup控制器实施的所有限制。因此，容器拥有底层主机的大部分权限。这个标志只存在于特定的用例中(例如在Docker中运行Docker)，一般不应该被使用
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令: 
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:
Privileged={{ .HostConfig.Privileged }}'
extraDetail.remediation: 不应该运行带有——privilege标志的容器
extraDetail.impact: 如果你启动一个没有——privileges标志的容器，它将不会有过多的默认功能
extraDetail.defaultValue: False
extraDetail.description_en: Using the --privileged flag provides all Linux kernel capabilities to the container to which it is applied and therefore overwrites the --cap-add and --cap-drop flags. For this reason you should ensure that it is not used.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The --privileged flag provides all capabilities to the container to which it is applied, and also lifts all the limitations enforced by the device cgroup controller. As a consequence this the container has most of the rights of the underlying host. This flag only exists to allow for specific use cases (for example running Docker within Docker) and should not generally be used.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Privileged={{ .HostConfig.Privileged }}' The above command should return Privileged=false for each container instance.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not run containers with the --privileged flag. For example, do not start a container using the command below: docker run --interactive --tty --privileged centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact_en: If you start a container without the --privileged flag, it will not have excessive default capabilities.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: False. 171 | Page

extraDetail.audit:

extraDetail.remediation:

extraDetail.impact: 如果你启动一个没有——privileges标志的容器，它将不会有过多的默认功能

extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chown root:root /etc/sysconfig/docker This sets the ownership and group ownership for the file to root.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure secrets are not stored in Dockerfiles
detail_zh: 确保机密未存储在Dockerfile中,

extraDetail.description: 不要在dockerfile中存储任何secrets
extraDetail.rationale: Docker镜像不是不透明的，并且包含关于用于构建它们的命令的信息。因为这些secrets不应该包含在用于构建镜像的dockerfile中，因为它们对镜像的任何用户都是可见的
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令: 
docker images

对上面列表中的每个image运行以下命令:
docker history <IMAGE ID>

并寻找所有的secrets
extraDetail.remediation: 不要在Dockerfile中存储任何类型的secrets。如果在构建过程中需要secrets，请使用secrets管理工具，例如Docker中包含的buildkit构建器
extraDetail.impact: Docker image的建立需要一个适当的secrets管理程序
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，在Dockerfile中存储配置secrets没有任何限制
extraDetail.description_en: Do not store any secrets in Dockerfiles.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker images are not opaque and contain information about the commands used to build them. As such secrets should not be included in Dockerfiles used to build images as they will be visible to any users of the image.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the below command to get the list of images: docker images Run the below command for each image in the list above, and look for any secrets: docker history <IMAGE ID>  Alternatively, if you have access to Dockerfile for the image, verify that there are no secrets as described above.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Do not store any kind of secrets within Dockerfiles. Where secrets are required during the build process, make use of a secrets management tool, such as the buildkit builder included with Docker.
extraDetail.impact_en: A proper secrets management process will be required for Docker image building.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, there are no restrictions on storing config secrets in the Dockerfiles.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that authorization for Docker client commands is enabled
detail_zh: 确保已启用对Docker客户端命令的授权,

extraDetail.description: 您应该使用本地Docker授权插件，或者使用带有Docker守护进程的第三方授权机制来管理对Docker客户端命令的访问
extraDetail.rationale:
Docker开箱即用的授权模式目前是“全有或全无”。这意味着任何具有访问Docker守护进程权限的用户都可以运行任何Docker客户机命令。对于访问Docker的API来联系守护进程的远程用户也是如此。如果需要更大的访问控制，可以创建授权插件并将其添加到Docker守护进程配置中。通过使用授权插件，Docker管理员可以为管理对Docker守护进程的访问配置粒度访问策略。
第三方的Docker集成可能会实现他们自己的授权模型，要求在Docker的本地授权插件(例如Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, Openshift)之外使用Docker守护进程进行授权
extraDetail.audit:
为了确认这个设置，应该检查dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置
要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
extraDetail.remediation:
步骤1:安装/创建授权插件。
步骤2:根据实际情况配置授权策略。步骤3:启动docker守护进程，如下所示:
dockerd --authorization-plugin=<PLUGIN_ID>
extraDetail.impact:
每个Docker命令都需要通过授权插件机制。这可能会对性能产生影响。
可以使用没有这种性能影响的替代机制
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，没有设置授权插件
extraDetail.description_en: You should use native Docker authorization plugins or a third party authorization mechanism with the Docker daemon to manage access to Docker client commands.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker’s out-of-the-box authorization model is currently "all or nothing". This means that any user with permission to access the Docker daemon can run any Docker client command. The same is true for remote users accessing Docker’s API to contact the daemon. If you require greater access control, you can create authorization plugins and add them to your Docker daemon configuration. Using an authorization plugin, a Docker administrator can configure granular access policies for managing access to the Docker daemon. Third party integrations of Docker may implement their own authorization models to require authorization with the Docker daemon outside of docker's native authorization plugin (i.e. Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, Openshift).
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting the dockerd start-up options and any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json should be reviewed. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd You should ensure that the --authorization-plugin parameter is set as appropriate if you are using docker native authorization. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed. 78 | Page
extraDetail.remediation_en: Step 1: Install/Create an authorization plugin. Step 2: Configure the authorization policy as desired. Step 3: Start the docker daemon as below: dockerd --authorization-plugin=<PLUGIN_ID>
extraDetail.impact_en: Each Docker command needs to pass through the authorization plugin mechanism. This may have a performance impact. It may be possible to use alternative mechanisms that do not have this performance hit.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, authorization plugins are not set up.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the Docker server certificate key file permissions are set to 400
detail_zh: 确保Docker服务器证书密钥文件权限设置为400,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证Docker服务器证书密钥文件(随——tlskey参数一起传递的文件)具有400的权限
extraDetail.rationale: Docker服务器证书密钥文件应该受到保护，不受任何篡改或不必要的读取。它保存Docker服务器证书的私钥。因此，它必须具有400的权限，以确保证书密钥文件不被修改
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证Docker服务器证书密钥文件具有400的权限:
stat -c %a <path to Docker server certificate key file>
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chmod 400 <path to Docker server certificate key file>
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker服务器证书密钥文件的权限可能不是400。默认的文件权限由操作系统或用户特定的umask值控制
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the Docker server certificate key file (the file that is passed along with the --tlskey parameter) has permissions of 400.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Docker server certificate key file should be protected from any tampering or unneeded reads. It holds the private key for the Docker server certificate. It must therefore have permissions of 400 to ensure that the certificate key file is not modified.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the Docker server certificate key file has permissions of 400: stat -c %a <path to Docker server certificate key file>
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chmod 400 <path to Docker server certificate key file> This sets the Docker server certificate key file permissions to 400.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the permissions for the Docker server certificate key file might not be 400. The default file permissions are governed by the operating system or user specific umask values.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure the default cgroup usage has been confirmed
detail_zh: 确保已确认默认的cgroup使用情况,

extraDetail.description: ——cgroup-parent选项允许你设置默认的cgroup父类，以用于所有容器。如果对此没有特定的使用要求，则应该保持默认设置
extraDetail.rationale:
系统管理员通常定义容器应该在其中运行的cgroup。即使系统管理员没有显式地定义cgroup，默认情况下容器也会在docker cgroup下运行。
可以附加到一个不同的cgroup，而不是默认的cgroup，但是这种类型的使用应该被监视和确认，因为附加到一个不同的cgroup，而不是默认的cgroup，可能会不均匀地共享资源，导致主机上的资源利用问题
extraDetail.audit:
为了确认这个设置，应该检查dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置
要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
你应该确保——cgroup-parent参数没有被设置，或者被设置为适当的非默认cgroup
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation: 默认设置符合良好的安全实践，可以保留在原地。如果你希望专门设置一个非默认的cgroup，在启动Docker守护进程时将——cgroup-parent参数传递给它
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，docker守护进程对fs cgroup驱动和系统使用/docker。为systemd cgroup驱动程序切片
extraDetail.description_en: The --cgroup-parent option allows you to set the default cgroup parent to use for all containers. If there is no specific usage requirement for this, the setting should be left at its default.
extraDetail.rationale_en: System administrators typically define cgroups under which containers are supposed to run. Even if cgroups are not explicitly defined by the system administrators, containers run under docker cgroup by default. It is possible to attach to a different cgroup other than the one which is the default, however this type of usage should be monitored and confirmed because attaching to a different cgroup other than the one that is a default, it could be possible to share resources unevenly causing resource utilization problems on the host.
extraDetail.audit_en: In order to confirm this setting, the dockerd start-up options and any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json should be reviewed. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd You should ensure that the --cgroup-parent parameter is either not set or is set as appropriate non-default cgroup. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be checked for this setting.
extraDetail.remediation_en: The default setting is in line with good security practice and can be left in situ. If you wish to specifically set a non-default cgroup, pass the --cgroup-parent parameter to the Docker daemon when starting it. For example, dockerd --cgroup-parent=/foobar
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, docker daemon uses /docker for fs cgroup driver and system.slice for systemd cgroup driver.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that registry certificate file permissions are set to 444 or more restrictively
detail_zh: 确保将注册表证书文件权限限制严格地设置为444或更高,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证所有注册表证书文件(通常位于/etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name>目录下)是否具有444的权限，或者是否设置了更严格的权限
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name>目录包含Docker注册表证书。这些证书文件必须具有444或更严格的权限，以确保没有特权的用户不能完全访问它们
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行下面的命令来验证注册中心证书文件是否具有444的权限，或者是否设置了更严格的权限:
find /etc/docker/certs.d/ -type f -exec stat -c "%a %n" {} \;
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
find /etc/docker/certs.d/ -type f -exec chmod 0444 {} \;
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，注册表证书文件的权限可能不是444。默认的文件权限由操作系统本身定义的系统或用户特定的umask值控制
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that all the registry certificate files (usually found under /etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name> directory) have permissions of 444 or are set more restrictively. Note that, by default, this directory might not exist if no registry certificate files are in place.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name> directory contains Docker registry certificates. These certificate files must have permissions of 444or more restrictive permissions in order to ensure that unprivileged users do not have full access to them..
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that registry certificate files have permissions of 444 or are more restrictively set. find /etc/docker/certs.d/ -type f -exec stat -c "%a %n" {} \;
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: find /etc/docker/certs.d/ -type f -exec chmod 0444 {} \;  This would set the permissions for the registry certificate files to 444.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the permissions for registry certificate files might not be 444. The default file permissions are governed by the system or user specific umask values which are defined within the operating system itself. 106 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the host's network namespace is not shared
detail_zh: 确保不共享主机的网络名称空间,

extraDetail.description: 当容器上的网络模式设置为——net=host时，容器不会放在单独的网络堆栈中。实际上，应用这个选项指示Docker不要将容器的网络装入容器。这样做的结果是，容器位于主Docker主机的“外部”，可以完全访问其网络接口
extraDetail.rationale: 选择这个选项是有潜在危险的。它允许容器进程像其他根进程一样打开预留的低编号端口。它还允许容器访问网络服务，例如Docker主机上的D-bus。容器进程可能会执行不希望的操作，比如关闭Docker主机。除非有非常具体的原因，否则不应使用此选项
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:
NetworkMode={{ .HostConfig.NetworkMode }}'
如果返回NetworkMode=host，这意味着在容器启动时传递了——net=host选项
extraDetail.remediation: 在启动任何容器时，不应该传递——net=host选项

extraDetail.description_en: When the networking mode on a container is set to --net=host, the container is not placed inside a separate network stack. This option should not be used unless there is a very specific reason for enabling it.

detail_en: Ensure that swarm manager is run in auto-lock mode
detail_zh: 确保群管理器在自动锁定模式下运行,

extraDetail.description: 您应该检查是否希望在自动锁定模式下运行Docker群集管理器
extraDetail.rationale:
当Docker重新启动时，用于加密群节点之间通信的TLS密钥和用于加密和解密磁盘上Raft日志的密钥都被加载到每个管理节点的内存中。您可以保护相互TLS加密密钥和用于加密和解密Raft日志的密钥。这个保护可以通过使用——autolock标志来初始化蜂群来实现。
启用——autolock后，当Docker重新启动时，必须首先使用Docker生成的密钥加密密钥来解锁集群。
这在高安全的环境中是有好处的，但是这应该与支持问题相平衡，如果集群不能自动启动，例如主机将经历停机
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行下面的命令:
docker info --format 'Swarm Autolock: {{.Swarm.Cluster.Spec.EncryptionConfig.AutoLockManagers }}'
如果结果为true，表示开启auto-lock模式。
您还可以运行下面的命令。如果返回一个键值，这意味着群集使用——autolock标志进行了初始化。如果输出没有设置解锁键，这意味着swarm没有使用——autolock标志进行初始化。这应该根据组织的IT安全政策进行审查
docker swarm unlock-key
extraDetail.remediation:
如果你正在初始化一个蜂群，使用下面的命令:
docker swarm init --autolock
如果你想在已有的集群管理节点上设置——autolock，使用以下命令:
docker swarm update --autolock
extraDetail.impact: 如果没有管理员手动干预输入解锁密钥，处于自动锁定模式的群集将无法从重启中恢复。这可能并不总是可取的，应该在策略级别进行审查
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker集群模式下覆盖网络交换的数据不加密
extraDetail.description_en: You should review whether you wish to run Docker swarm manager in auto-lock mode.
extraDetail.rationale_en: When Docker restarts, both the TLS key used to encrypt communication among swarm nodes, and the key used to encrypt and decrypt Raft logs on disk, are loaded into each manager node's memory. You could protect the mutual TLS encryption key and the key used to encrypt and decrypt Raft logs at rest. This protection could be enabled by initializing the swarm with the --autolock flag. With --autolock enabled, when Docker restarts, you must unlock the swarm first, using a key encryption key generated by Docker when the swarm was initialized. This has benefits in a high security environment, however these should be balanced against the support issues caused by the swarm not starting automatically if, for example the host were to experience an outage.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below docker info --format 'Swarm Autolock: {{ .Swarm.Cluster.Spec.EncryptionConfig.AutoLockManagers }}' If the result is true, auto-lock mode is enable. You could also run the command below. If a key value is returned, it means that the swarm was initialized with the --autolock flag. If the output is no unlock key is set, it means that swarm was NOT initialized with the --autolock flag. This should be reviewed in line with the organization's IT Security policy. docker swarm unlock-key
extraDetail.remediation_en: If you are initializing a swarm, use the command below. docker swarm init --autolock If you want to set --autolock on an existing swarm manager node, use the following command. docker swarm update --autolock
extraDetail.impact_en: A swarm in auto-lock mode will not recover from a restart without manual intervention from an administrator to enter the unlock key. This may not always be desirable, and should be reviewed at a policy level.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the swarm manager does not run in auto-lock mode.

detail_en: Ensure the default ulimit is configured appropriately
detail_zh: 确保正确配置了默认ulimit,

extraDetail.description: 在您的环境中适当地设置默认的ulimit选项
extraDetail.rationale:
Ulimit提供对shell和它所启动的进程可用的资源的控制。明智地设置系统资源限制可以避免fork炸弹等灾难。有时，即使是友好的用户和合法的进程也会过度使用系统资源，从而导致系统不可用。

extraDetail.audit:
要确认这个设置，你应该检查dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置。
要https://docs.docker.com/engine/reference/commandline/dockerd/#daemon -user-
namespace-options查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
Ps -ef | grep dockerd
确保——default-ulimit参数的设置是适当的。
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation: 以守护进程模式运行Docker，并传递——default-ulimit作为参数，在您的环境中使用相应的ulimit，并符合您的安全策略
extraDetail.impact: 如果ulimit设置不正确，可能会导致系统资源出现问题，可能会导致拒绝服务的情况。因此，为了对系统资源有适当的控制，请根据您的环境需要定义一个默认的ulimit
extraDetail.defaultValue: 缺省情况下，没有设置ulimit
extraDetail.description_en: Set the default ulimit options as appropriate in your environment.
extraDetail.rationale_en: ulimit provides control over the resources available to the shell and to processes which it starts. Setting system resource limits judiciously can save you from disasters such as a fork bomb. On occasion, even friendly users and legitimate processes can overuse system resources and can make the system unusable. Setting the default ulimit for the Docker daemon enforces the ulimit for all container instances. In this case you would not need to setup ulimit for each container instance. However, the default ulimit can be overridden during container runtime, if needed. Therefore, in order to have proper control over system resources, define a default ulimit as is needed in your environment.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting you should review the dockerd start-up options and any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd Ensure that the --default-ulimit parameter is set as appropriate. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed for this setting.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run Docker in daemon mode and pass --default-ulimit as argument with respective ulimits as appropriate in your environment and in line with your security policy. For Example, dockerd --default-ulimit nproc=1024:2048 --default-ulimit nofile=100:200
extraDetail.impact_en: If ulimits are set incorrectly this could cause issues with system resources, possibly causing a denial of service condition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, no ulimit is set.

detail_en: Ensure that CPU priority is set appropriately on containers
detail_zh: 确保在容器上正确设置了CPU优先级,

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，Docker主机上的所有容器平等地共享资源。通过使用Docker主机的资源管理功能，您可以控制容器可能消耗的主机CPU资源
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，CPU时间在容器之间平均分配。如果希望控制容器实例之间可用的CPU资源，可以使用CPU共享特性。CPU共享允许您将一个容器的优先级高于其他容器，并防止低优先级容器占用其他进程可能需要的CPU资源。这确保了高优先级容器能够声明它们所需的CPU运行时
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:CpuShares={{ .HostConfig.CpuShares }}'
如果上面的命令返回0或1024，则意味着CPU共享没有到位。如果它返回1024以外的非零值，则意味着它们已经存在
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该根据容器在组织中的优先级来管理它们之间的CPU运行时。为此，使用——cpu-shares参数启动容器
extraDetail.impact: 如果没有正确分配CPU阈值，容器进程可能会耗尽资源并失去响应。如果主机的CPU资源不受约束，则CPU共享对单个资源没有任何限制
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker主机上的所有容器平等地共享它们的资源。不强制执行CPU共享
extraDetail.description_en: By default, all containers on a Docker host share resources equally. By using the resource management capabilities of the Docker host you can control the host CPU resources that a container may consume.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By default, CPU time is divided between containers equally. If you wish to control available CPU resources amongst container instances, you can use the CPU sharing feature. CPU sharing allows you to prioritize one container over others and prevents lower priority containers from absorbing CPU resources which may be required by other processes. This ensures that high priority containers are able to claim the CPU runtime they require.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command. docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: CpuShares={{ .HostConfig.CpuShares }}' If the above command returns 0 or 1024, it means that CPU shares are not in place. If it returns a non-zero value other than 1024, it means that they are in place.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should manage the CPU runtime between your containers dependent on their priority within your organization. To do so start the container using the --cpu-shares argument. For example, you could run a container as below: docker run -d --cpu-shares 512 centos sleep 1000 In the example above, the container is started with CPU shares of 50% of what other containers use. So if the other container has CPU shares of 80%, this container will have CPU shares of 40%. Every new container will have 1024 shares of CPU by default. However, this value is shown as 0 if you run the command mentioned in the audit section. If you set one container’s CPU shares to 512 it will receive half of the CPU time compared to the other containers. So if you take 1024 as 100% you can then derive the number that you should set for respective CPU shares. For example, use 512 if you want to set it to 50% and 256 if you want to set it 25%. You can also view the current CPU shares in the file /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/docker/<CONTAINER ID>/cpu.shares.
extraDetail.impact_en: If you do not correctly assign CPU thresholds, the container process may run out of resources and become unresponsive. If CPU resources on the host are not constrainted, CPU shares do not place any restrictions on individual resources.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all containers on a Docker host share their resources equally. No CPU shares are enforced.

detail_en: Ensure only trusted users are allowed to control Docker daemon

extraDetail.description: Docker守护进程目前需要访问Docker套接字，默认情况下，该套接字由root用户和Docker组拥有
extraDetail.rationale: Docker允许您在Docker主机和来宾容器之间共享目录，而不限制容器的访问权限。这意味着您可以启动一个容器，并将主机上的/目录映射到该容器。这样容器就可以不受任何限制地修改主机文件系统。这意味着您只需作为docker组的成员，然后启动一个映射主机上根/目录的容器，就可以获得提升的特权

在docker主机上执行以下命令，确保只有受信任的用户是docker组的成员
getent group docker
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该从docker组中删除任何不受信任的用户。此外，您不应该创建从主机到容器卷的敏感目录的映射
extraDetail.impact: 如果实现了上述指示，那么作为普通用户构建和执行容器的权利将受到限制
extraDetail.description_en: The Docker daemon currently requires access to the Docker socket which is, by default, owned by the user root and the group docker.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker allows you to share a directory between the Docker host and a guest container without limiting the access rights of the container. This means that you can start a container and map the / directory on your host to the container. The container would then be able to modify your host file system without any restrictions. This means that you could gain elevated privileges simply by being a member of the docker group and subsequently start a container which maps the root / directory on the host.
extraDetail.audit_en: Execute the following command on the docker host and ensure that only trusted users are members of the docker group. getent group docker
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should remove any untrusted users from the docker group. Additionally, you should not create a mapping of sensitive directories from the host to container volumes.
extraDetail.impact_en: Provided the proceeding instructions are implemented, rights to build and execute containers as normal user would be restricted.

extraDetail.description_en: The default ulimit is set at the Docker daemon level. However, if you need to, you may override the default ulimit setting during container runtime.
extraDetail.rationale_en: ulimit provides control over the resources available to the shell and to processes started by it. extraDetail.remediation_en: You should only override the default ulimit settings if needed in a specific case. For example, to override default ulimit settings start a container as below: docker run -ti -d --ulimit nofile=1024:1024 centos sleep 1000
extraDetail.impact_en: If ulimits are not set correctly, overutilization by individual containers could make the host system unusable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the minimum number of manager nodes have been created in a swarm
detail_zh: 确保在一个集群中创建了最少数量的管理器节点,

extraDetail.description: 您应该确保在一个群集中创建所需的管理器节点的最小数量
extraDetail.rationale:
集群中的管理节点对集群具有控制权，可以修改集群的配置，包括修改安全参数。拥有过多的管理节点会使蜂群更容易妥协。
如果管理器节点不需要容错，则应该选举一个节点作为管理器。如果需要容错，则应该配置最小奇数以实现适当的容错级别。这应该总是一个奇数，以确保达到多数派
extraDetail.audit:
运行docker info并验证管理器的数量:
docker info --format '{{ .Swarm.Managers }}'
或者运行以下命令:
docker node ls | grep 'Leader'
extraDetail.remediation:
如果配置的manager数量过多，可以使用以下命令将多余的节点降级为worker:
docker node demote <ID>
其中为待降级管理器的节点ID值
extraDetail.defaultValue: 只需要一个管理器就可以启动给定的集群
extraDetail.description_en: You should ensure that the minimum number of required manager nodes is created in a swarm.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Manager nodes within a swarm have control over the swarm and can change its configuration, including modifying security parameters. Having excessive manager nodes could render the swarm more susceptible to compromise. If fault tolerance is not required in the manager nodes, a single node should be elected as a manger. If fault tolerance is required then the smallest odd number to achieve the appropriate level of tolerance should be configured. This should always be an odd number in order to ensure that a quorum is reached.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run docker info and verify the number of managers. docker info --format '{{ .Swarm.Managers }}'  Alternatively run the below command. docker node ls | grep 'Leader'
extraDetail.remediation_en: If an excessive number of managers is configured, the excess nodes can be demoted to workers using the following command: docker node demote <ID>  Where is the node ID value of the manager to be demoted. 236 | Page
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Only a single manager is required to start a given cluster.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure centralized and remote logging is configured
detail_zh: 确保配置了集中式和远程日志记录,

extraDetail.description: Docker支持各种日志机制。一种较好的日志存储方法是支持集中和远程管理
extraDetail.rationale: 集中式和远程日志记录可以确保所有重要的日志记录都是安全的，即使在出现重大数据可用性问题的情况下也是如此。Docker支持各种日志记录方法，您应该使用最符合您的IT安全策略的方法
extraDetail.audit:
运行docker info并确保日Logging Driver属性设置为适当的:
docker info --format '{{ .LoggingDriver }}'
或者，下面的命令将为您提供——log-driver设置。如果已配置，则应确保设置正确
ps -ef | grep dockerd
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation:
步骤1:根据文档设置所需的日志驱动程序
步骤2:使用日志记录驱动程序启动docker守护进程
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器日志以json文件的形式维护
extraDetail.description_en: Docker supports various logging mechanisms. A preferable method for storing logs is one that supports centralized and remote management.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Centralized and remote logging ensures that all important log records are safe even in the event of a major data availability issue . Docker supports various logging methods and you should use the one that best corresponds to your IT security policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run docker info and ensure that the Logging Driver property set as appropriate. docker info --format '{{ .LoggingDriver }}'  Alternatively, the below command would give you the --log-driver setting. If configured you should ensure that it is set appropriately. ps -ef | grep dockerd The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed for this setting.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Step 1: Set up the desired log driver following its documentation. Step 2: Start the docker daemon using that logging driver. For example: dockerd --log-driver=syslog --log-opt syslog-address=tcp://192.xxx.xxx.xxx
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, container logs are maintained as json files 80 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that cgroup usage is confirmed
detail_zh: 确保已确认cgroup使用情况,

extraDetail.description: 当容器实例化时，可以附加到特定的cgroup。确认cgroup的使用将确保容器在定义的cgroup中运行
extraDetail.rationale:
系统管理员通常定义容器应该在其中运行的cgroup。如果系统管理员没有显式定义cgroup，容器默认在docker cgroup中运行。
在运行时，可以将容器附加到最初定义的cgroup以外的其他cgroup。应该对这种使用进行监视和确认，因为通过附加到不同的cgroup，可能会将多余的权限和资源授予容器，因此这可能被证明是一个安全风险
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:
CgroupParent={{ .HostConfig.CgroupParent }}'
上面的命令返回正在运行容器的cgroup。如果为空，则意味着容器在默认的docker cgroup下运行。其他返回值表示系统没有按照良好的安全实践进行配置
extraDetail.remediation: 除非严格要求，否则不应该在docker run命令中使用——cgroup-parent选项
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器在docker cgroup下运行
extraDetail.description_en: It is possible to attach to a particular cgroup when a container is instantiated. Confirming cgroup usage would ensure that containers are running in defined cgroups.
extraDetail.rationale_en: System administrators typically define cgroups in which containers are supposed to run. If cgroups are not explicitly defined by the system administrator, containers run in the docker cgroup by default. At run time, it is possible to attach a container to a different cgroup other than the one originally defined. This usage should be monitored and confirmed, as by attaching to a different cgroup, excess permissions and resources might be granted to the container and this can therefore prove to be a security risk.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: CgroupParent={{ .HostConfig.CgroupParent }}'  The above command returns the cgroup where the containers are running. If it is blank, it means that containers are running under the default docker cgroup. Any other return value indicates that the system is not configured in line with good security practice.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not use the --cgroup-parent option within the docker run command unless strictly required.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, containers run under docker cgroup. 213 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the /etc/sysconfig/docker file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictively
detail_zh: 确保将/ etc / sysconfig / docker文件权限限制严格地设置为644或更高,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证/etc/sysconfig/docker文件权限是否正确设置为644或更严格
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/sysconfig/docker文件包含可能改变Docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该只能由根用户写，以确保它不会被特权较低的用户修改
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证文件权限是否被正确设置为644或更严格:
stat -c %a /etc/sysconfig/docker
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chmod 644 /etc/sysconfig/docker
extraDetail.defaultValue: 此文件可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the /etc/sysconfig/docker file permissions are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/sysconfig/docker file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the Docker daemon. It should therefore be writeable only by root in order to ensure that it is not modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the file permissions are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively: stat -c %a /etc/sysconfig/docker
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chmod 644 /etc/sysconfig/docker This sets the file permissions for this file to 644.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system and in this case, this recommendation is not applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that COPY is used instead of ADD in Dockerfiles
detail_zh: 确保在Dockerfile中使用COPY而不是ADD,

extraDetail.description: 你应该在Dockerfile中使用COPY指令而不是ADD指令
extraDetail.rationale: COPY指令只是将文件从本地主机复制到容器文件系统。ADD指令可能从远程url检索文件并执行诸如解包等操作。因此，ADD指令会带来安全风险。例如，恶意文件可能不经过扫描直接从url访问，或者可能存在与解压相关的漏洞
extraDetail.audit:
运行下面的命令来获取image列表:
docker images
对上面列表中的每个image运行下面的命令，查找ADD指令:
docker history <IMAGE ID>
或者，如果您可以访问镜像的Dockerfile，您应该验证没有ADD指令
extraDetail.remediation: 你应该在dockerfile中使用COPY指令而不是ADD指令
extraDetail.impact: 如果应用程序需要作为ADD指令一部分的功能，例如，如果需要从远程url检索文件，那么在实现此控件时需要格外小心
extraDetail.description_en: You should use the COPY instruction instead of the ADD instruction in the Dockerfile.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The COPY instruction simply copies files from the local host machine to the container file system. The ADD instruction could potentially retrieve files from remote URLs and perform operations such as unpacking them. The ADD instruction therefore introduces security risks. For example, malicious files may be directly accessed from URLs without scanning, or there may be vulnerabilities associated with decompressing them.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the command below to get the list of images: docker images  Run the command below against each image in the list above and look for any ADD instructions: docker history <IMAGE ID> Alternatively, if you have access to the Dockerfile for the image, you should verify that there are no ADD instructions.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should use COPY rather than ADD instructions in Dockerfiles.
extraDetail.impact_en: Care needs to be taken in implementing this control if the application requires functionality that is part of the ADD instruction, for example, if you need to retrieve files from remote URLs.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable 157 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the memory usage for containers is limited
detail_zh: 确保限制容器的内存使用,

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，Docker主机上的所有容器平等地共享资源。通过使用Docker主机的资源管理功能，您可以控制容器能够使用的内存量
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，容器可以使用主机上的所有内存。您可以使用内存限制机制来防止拒绝服务的发生，即一个容器消耗主机的所有资源，而同一主机上的其他容器因此无法工作。没有内存使用限制会导致一些问题，一个容器很容易使整个系统不稳定，从而导致不可用
extraDetail.audit:
你应该运行下面的命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Memory={{
.HostConfig.Memory }}'
如果该命令返回0，则表示没有设置内存限制;如果返回非零值，则表示它们已经存在
extraDetail.remediation: 通过使用——memory参数，你应该只在容器需要多少内存的情况下运行它
extraDetail.impact: 如果没有对每个容器设置正确的内存限制，一个进程可能会扩大其使用量，导致其他容器耗尽资源
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker主机上的所有容器平等地共享它们的资源，不强制执行内存限制
extraDetail.description_en: By default, all containers on a Docker host share resources equally. By using the resource management capabilities of the Docker host, you can control the amount of memory that a container is able to use.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By default a container can use all of the memory on the host. You can use memory limit mechanisms to prevent a denial of service occurring where one container consumes all of the host’s resources and other containers on the same host are therefore not able to function. Having no limit on memory usage can lead to issues where one container can easily make the whole system unstable and as a result unusable.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Memory={{ .HostConfig.Memory }}' If this command returns 0, it means that memory limits are not in place; if it returns a non-zero value, it means that they are in place.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the container with only as much memory as it requires by using the --memory argument. For example, you could run a container using the command below: docker run -d --memory 256m centos sleep 1000 In the example above, the container is started with a memory limit of 256 MB. Verify the memory settings by using the command below: docker inspect --format='{{ .Id }}: Memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} KernelMemory={{.HostConfig.KernelMemory}} Swap={{.HostConfig.MemorySwap}}' <CONTAINER ID>
extraDetail.impact_en: If correct memory limits are not set on each container, one process can expand its usage and cause other containers to run out of resources.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all containers on a Docker host share their resources equally and no memory limits are enforced.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure auditing is configured for Docker files and directories - /usr/bin/containerd
detail_zh: 确保为Docker文件和目录配置了审核-/ usr / bin / containerd

extraDetail.description: 适用情况下，审计/usr/bin/ containd
extraDetail.rationale: 除了审计普通的Linux文件系统和系统调用之外，还应该审计所有与Docker相关的文件和目录。Docker守护进程以根权限运行，其行为依赖于一些关键文件和目录。/usr/bin/containerd就是这样一个文件，因此应该进行审计
extraDetail.audit:
您应该验证是否存在与/usr/bin/containerd文件对应的审计规则。例如，您可以执行以下命令:
auditctl -l | grep /usr/bin/containerd
这应该显示一个/usr/bin/containerd文件的规则
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该为/usr/bin/containerd文件添加一条规则
extraDetail.impact: 审计可以生成较大的日志文件。您应该确保定期轮换和归档这些文件。还应该为审计日志创建一个单独的分区，以避免填充任何其他关键分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不审计Docker相关的文件和目录。文件/usr/bin/containd可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用
extraDetail.description_en: Audit /usr/bin/containerd if applicable.
extraDetail.rationale_en: As well as auditing the normal Linux file system and system calls, you should audit all Docker related files and directories. The Docker daemon runs with root privileges and its behavior depends on some key files and directories. /usr/bin/containerd is one such file and as such should be audited.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should verify that there is an audit rule corresponding to /usr/bin/containerd file. For example, you could execute the command below: auditctl -l | grep /usr/bin/containerd This should display a rule for /usr/bin/containerd file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should add a rule for the /usr/bin/containerd file. For example: Add the line below to the /etc/audit/audit.rules file: -w /usr/bin/containerd -k docker  Then restart the audit daemon. For example: systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact_en: Auditing can generate large log files. You should ensure that these are rotated and archived periodically. A separate partition should also be created for audit logs to avoid filling up any other critical partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker related files and directories are not audited. The file /usr/bin/containerd may not be present on the system and in that case, this recommendation is not applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure live restore is enabled
detail_zh: 确保启用了实时还原,

extraDetail.description: ——live-restore选项使Docker完全支持无守护进程的容器。它确保Docker在关闭或恢复时不会停止容器，并在重新启动时正确地重新连接到容器
extraDetail.rationale: 一个重要的安全因素是可用性。在Docker守护进程中设置——live-restore标志可以确保当容器不可用时，它的执行不会中断。这也使得更新和修补Docker守护进程更容易，而不会导致应用程序停机
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行docker info并确保Live Restore Enabled属性设置为true
docker info --format '{{ .LiveRestoreEnabled }}'
或者，您可以运行以下命令，并确保使用了——live-restore
ps -ef | grep dockerd
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容，以确保设置到位
extraDetail.remediation: 以守护进程模式运行Docker，并将——live-restore作为参数传递给它
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，——live-restore没有启用
extraDetail.description_en: The --live-restore option enables full support of daemon-less containers within Docker. It ensures that Docker does not stop containers on shutdown or restore and that it properly reconnects to the container when restarted.
extraDetail.rationale_en: One of the important security triads is availability. Setting the --live-restore flag within the Docker daemon ensures that container execution is not interrupted when it is not available. This also makes it easier to update and patch the Docker daemon without application downtime.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run docker info and ensure that the Live Restore Enabled property is set to true. docker info --format '{{ .LiveRestoreEnabled }}'  Alternatively, you could run the below command and ensure that --live-restore is in use. ps -ef | grep dockerd The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed to ensure this setting is in place.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Run Docker in daemon mode and pass --live-restore to it as an argument. For Example, dockerd --live-restore
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, --live-restore is not enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure network traffic is restricted between containers on the default bridge
detail_zh: 确保默认网桥上的容器之间的网络流量受到限制,

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，允许默认网桥上同一主机上的容器之间的所有网络流量。如果不需要，则限制所有容器间通信。将需要通信的特定容器链接在一起。或者，您可以创建自定义网络并只连接需要与该自定义网络通信的容器
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，在默认网桥上同一主机上的所有容器之间启用不受限制的网络流量。因此，每个容器都有可能通过同一主机上的容器网络读取所有数据包。这可能导致向其他容器无意地和不希望的信息公开。因此，需要限制默认网桥上的容器间通信
extraDetail.audit:
运行以下命令并验证默认网桥已配置为限制容器间通信
docker network ls --quiet | xargs docker network inspect --format '{{ .Name
}}: {{ .Options }}'
对于默认网桥，它应该返回com.docker.network.bridge.enable_icc:false
extraDetail.remediation:
编辑Docker守护进程配置文件，确保禁用了icc。它应该包括以下设置
"icc": false
或者，直接运行docker守护进程并传递——icc=false作为参数
或者，您也可以按照Docker文档创建一个自定义网络，并只加入需要与该自定义网络通信的容器。——icc参数只适用于默认的docker桥接，如果使用自定义网络，则应该采用分段网络的方法。
为了使这个控制完全有效，连接到docker0桥的所有容器都应该放弃NET_RAW功能，否则，受影响的容器可以使用原始以太网数据包与其他容器通信，尽管有这种限制
extraDetail.impact: 容器间通信将在默认网桥上被禁用。如果需要在同一主机上的容器之间进行通信，则需要使用容器链接显式地定义它，或者必须定义自定义网络
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，允许在缺省网桥上进行所有容器间通信
extraDetail.description_en: By default, all network traffic is allowed between containers on the same host on the default network bridge. If not desired, restrict all inter-container communication. Link specific containers together that require communication. Alternatively, you can create custom network and only join containers that need to communicate to that custom network.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By default, unrestricted network traffic is enabled between all containers on the same host on the default network bridge. Thus, each container has the potential of reading all packets across the container network on the same host. This might lead to an unintended and unwanted disclosure of information to other containers. Hence, restrict inter-container communication on the default network bridge.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the below command and verify that the default network bridge has been configured to restrict inter-container communication. docker network ls --quiet | xargs docker network inspect --format '{{ .Name }}: {{ .Options }}'  It should return com.docker.network.bridge.enable_icc:false for the default network bridge.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Edit the Docker daemon configuration file to ensure that icc is disabled. It should include the following setting "icc": false Alernatively, run the docker daemon directly and pass --icc=false as an argument. For Example, dockerd --icc=false Alternatively, you can follow the Docker documentation and create a custom network and only join containers that need to communicate to that custom network. The --icc parameter only applies to the default docker bridge, if custom networks are used then the approach of segmenting networks should be adopted instead. In order for this control to be fully effective, all containers connected to the docker0 bridge should drop the NET_RAW capability, otherwise a compromised container could use raw ethernet packets to communicate with other containers despite this restriction.
extraDetail.impact_en: Inter-container communication would be disabled on the default network bridge. If any communication between containers on the same host is desired, then it needs to be explicitly defined using container linking or alternatively custom networks have to be defined.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all inter-container communication is allowed on the default network bridge.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure Docker is allowed to make changes to iptables
detail_zh: 确保允许Docker对iptables进行更改,

extraDetail.description: iptables防火墙用于建立、维护和检查Linux内核内部的IP包过滤规则表。应该允许Docker守护进程更改iptables规则集
extraDetail.rationale: Docker永远不会改变你的系统iptables规则，除非你允许它这么做。如果您允许这样做，Docker服务器将自动进行任何必要的更改。我们建议让Docker自动更改iptables，以避免可能影响容器之间以及与外部世界通信的网络错误配置。此外，这还减少了每次添加容器或修改网络选项时更新iptables的管理开销
extraDetail.audit:
要确认这个设置，你应该查看dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的设置
要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
确保——iptables参数不存在或者没有设置为false。还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation:
不要运行带有——iptables=false参数的Docker守护进程。例如，不启动Docker守护进程如下:
dockerd --iptables=false
extraDetail.impact: Docker守护进程服务需要在启动之前启用iptables规则。在Docker守护进程运行过程中，任何重新启动iptables都可能导致Docker创建的规则丢失。在iptables安装中添加iptables-persistent可以帮助减轻这种影响
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，iptables为true
extraDetail.description_en: The iptables firewall is used to set up, maintain, and inspect the tables of IP packet filter rules within the Linux kernel. The Docker daemon should be allowed to make changes to the iptables ruleset.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker will never make changes to your system iptables rules unless you allow it to do so. If you do allow this, Docker server will automatically make any required changes. We recommended letting Docker make changes to iptables automatically in order to avoid networking misconfigurations that could affect the communication between containers and with the outside world. Additionally, this reduces the administrative overhead of updating iptables every time you add containers or modify networking options.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting you should review the dockerd start-up options and the settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd Ensure that the --iptables parameter is either not present or not set to false. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed for this setting.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Do not run the Docker daemon with --iptables=false parameter. For example, do not start the Docker daemon as below: dockerd --iptables=false
extraDetail.impact_en: The Docker daemon service requires iptables rules to be enabled before it starts. Any restarts of iptables during Docker daemon operation may result in losing Docker created rules. Adding iptables-persistent to your iptables install can assist with mitigation of this impact.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, iptables is set to true.

detail_en: CVE-2020-15157 - Ensure containerd version is up to date (>v1.2.14)

detail_en: Ensure auditing is configured for the Docker daemon
detail_zh: 确保为Docker守护程序配置了审核

extraDetail.description: 审计所有Docker守护进程活动
extraDetail.rationale: 除了审计普通的Linux文件系统和系统调用之外，还应该审计Docker守护进程。因为这个守护进程以根权限运行。审计它的活动和使用是非常重要的
extraDetail.audit:
验证Docker守护进程是否存在审计规则。例如，您可以执行以下命令:
auditctl -l | grep /usr/bin/dockerd
这将显示与Docker守护进程相关联的规则
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该为/etc/docker/daemon.json文件添加一条规则,例如:
将以下行添加到/etc/audit/audit.rules文件中:
-w /usr/bin/dockerd -k docker
然后，使用以下命令重新启动审计守护进程
systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact: 审计可以生成较大的日志文件。您应该确保定期轮换和归档这些文件。还应该为审计日志创建一个单独的分区，以避免填充任何其他关键分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不审计Docker守护进程
extraDetail.description_en: Audit all Docker daemon activities.
extraDetail.rationale_en: As well as auditing the normal Linux file system and system calls, you should also audit the Docker daemon. Because this daemon runs with root privileges. It is very important to audit its activities and usage.
extraDetail.audit_en: Verify that there are audit rules for the Docker daemon. For example, you could execute the following command: auditctl -l | grep /usr/bin/dockerd This should show the rules associated with the Docker daemon.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should add rules for the Docker daemon. For example: Add the line below to the /etc/audit/audit.rules file: -w /usr/bin/dockerd -k docker Then, restart the audit daemon using the following command systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact_en: Auditing can generate large log files. You should ensure that these are rotated and archived periodically. A separate partition should also be created for audit logs to avoid filling up any other critical partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the Docker daemon is not audited.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that docker.socket file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictive
detail_zh: 确保将docker.socket文件权限设置为644或更高的限制,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证docker上的文件权限。套接字文件被正确设置为644或更严格
extraDetail.rationale: docker.socket文件包含可能改变Docker远程API行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该只能由根用户写，以确保它不会被特权较低的用户修改
extraDetail.audit:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，您应该执行下面的命令，包括正确的文件路径，以验证文件权限是否设置为644或更严格
例如:
stat -c %a /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket
extraDetail.remediation:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket
如果该文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，则应该执行以下命令，包括正确的文件路径，以将文件权限设置为644
例如:
chmod 644 /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket
extraDetail.defaultValue: 该文件可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用。默认情况下，如果文件存在，权限应该设置为644或更严格
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the file permissions on the docker.socket file are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The docker.socket file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the Docker remote API. It should therefore be writeable only by root in order to ensure that it is not modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file exists, you should execute the command below, including the correct file path in order to verify that the file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictively. For example: stat -c %a /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket
extraDetail.remediation_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file does exist, you should execute the command below, including the correct file path to set the file permissions to 644. For example, chmod 644 /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system and in that case, this recommendation is not applicable. By default, if the file is present, the permissions should be set to 644 or more restrictively.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that /etc/docker directory permissions are set to 755 or more restrictively
detail_zh: 确保将/ etc / docker目录权限限制严格地设置为755或更高,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证/etc/docker目录权限是否正确设置为755或更严格
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/docker目录包含证书和密钥，以及各种敏感文件。因此，它应该只能由根用户写，以确保权限较低的用户不能修改它
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证该目录是否具有755或更严格的权限:
stat -c %a /etc/docker
extraDetail.remediation:
应该执行以下命令:
chmod 755 /etc/docker
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，该目录的权限设置为755
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the /etc/docker directory permissions are correctly set to 755 or more restrictively.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/docker directory contains certificates and keys in addition to various sensitive files. It should therefore only be writeable by root to ensure that it can not be modified by a less privileged user.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the directory has permissions of 755 or more restrictive ones: stat -c %a /etc/docker
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the following command: chmod 755 /etc/docker This sets the permissions for the directory to 755.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the permissions for this directory are set to 755.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that daemon.json file permissions are set to 644 or more restrictive
detail_zh: 确保将daemon.json文件权限设置为644或更高的限制,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证是否存在daemon.json，其文件权限是否被正确设置为644或更严格
extraDetail.rationale: daemon.json文件包含可能改变docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该只能由根用户写，以确保它不会被特权较低的用户修改
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证文件权限是否被正确设置为644或更严格:
stat -c %a /etc/docker/daemon.json
如果该命令返回如下结果，则该文件不存在，此检查不适用:
stat: cannot stat '/etc/docker/daemon.json': No such file or directory
extraDetail.remediation:
如果文件存在，您应该执行以下命令:
chmod 644 /etc/docker/daemon.json
extraDetail.defaultValue: 该文件可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that if the daemon.json is present its file permissions are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The daemon.json file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the docker daemon. Therefore it should be writeable only by root to ensure it is not modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the file permissions are correctly set to 644 or more restrictively: stat -c %a /etc/docker/daemon.json If the command returns the result below, the file is not present and this check does not apply: stat: cannot stat '/etc/docker/daemon.json': No such file or directory
extraDetail.remediation_en: If the file is present, you should execute the command below: chmod 644 /etc/docker/daemon.json This sets the file permissions for this file to 644.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system, and in that case, this recommendation is not applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that containers use only trusted base images
detail_zh: 确保容器仅使用受信任的基本镜像,

extraDetail.description: 您应该确保使用的容器镜像是从头开始编写的，或者是基于通过安全通道下载的另一个已建立的、受信任的基本镜像
extraDetail.rationale: 官方存储库包含Docker社区或其供应商策划和优化的Docker镜像。不能保证这些镜像是安全的，不包含安全漏洞或恶意代码。因此，在从Docker和第三方获取容器镜像时应保持谨慎，并应根据组织安全策略审查运行这些镜像
extraDetail.audit:
您应该通过执行下面的命令来检查主机上存在哪些Docker镜像:
docker images
这个命令列出了Docker主机上当前可用的所有容器镜像。然后，您应该检查每个镜像的起源，并根据组织的安全策略检查其内容。
您可以使用下面的命令来查看提交到镜像的历史
docker history <imageName>
extraDetail.remediation:
以下过程对于建立特定镜像的信任非常有用
•配置和使用Docker内容信任
•查看每个Docker镜像的历史，评估其风险，取决于希望使用它部署的应用程序的敏感性
•定期扫描Docker镜像以查找漏洞
extraDetail.description_en: You should ensure that container images you use are either written from scratch or are based on another established and trusted base image downloaded over a secure channel.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Official repositories contain Docker images curated and optimized by the Docker community or by their vendor. There is no guarantee that these images are safe and do not contain security vulnerabilities or malicious code. Caution should therefore be exercised when obtaining container images from Docker and third parties and running these images should be reviewed in line with organizational security policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should review what Docker images are present on the host by executing the command below: docker images This command lists all the container images that are currently available for use on the Docker host. You should then review the origin of each image and review its contents in line with your organization's security policy. You can use the command below to review the history of commits to the image. docker history <imageName>
extraDetail.remediation_en: The following procedures are useful for establishing trust for a specific image. • Configure and use Docker Content trust. • View the history of each Docker image to evaluate its risk, dependent on the sensitivity of the application you wish to deploy using it. • Scan Docker images for vulnerabilities at regular intervals. 143 | Page
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that docker exec commands are not used with the privileged option
detail_zh: 确保docker exec命令未与特权选项一起使用,

extraDetail.description: 你不应该使用docker exec带有——privileges选项
extraDetail.rationale: 在docker exec命令中使用——privilege选项为该命令提供了扩展的Linux功能。这可能是一种不安全的实践，特别是在运行功能减少或限制增强的容器时
extraDetail.audit:
如果按照第1节的建议启用了审计，可以使用下面的命令过滤掉使用——privilege选项的docker exec命令
ausearch -k docker | grep exec | grep privilege
extraDetail.remediation: 你不应该在docker exec命令中使用——privilege选项
extraDetail.impact: 如果您需要在容器中增强功能，那么可以使用它所需要的所有权限来运行它。这些应该单独指定
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，docker exec命令运行时不带——privilege选项
extraDetail.description_en: You should not use docker exec with the --privileged option.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Using the --privileged option in docker exec commands gives extended Linux capabilities to the command. This could potentially be an insecure practice, particularly when you are running containers with reduced capabilities or with enhanced restrictions.
extraDetail.audit_en: If you have auditing enabled as recommended in Section 1, you can use the command below to filter out docker exec commands that use the --privileged option. ausearch -k docker | grep exec | grep privileged
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not use the --privileged option in docker exec commands.
extraDetail.impact_en: If you need enhanced capabilities within a container, then run it with all the permissions it requires. These should be specified individually.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the docker exec command runs without the --privileged option.
