creator: default
detail_en: Ensure auditing is configured for Docker files and directories - /var/lib/docker
detail_zh: 确保为Docker文件和目录配置了审核-/ var / lib / docker

extraDetail.description: 审计/var/lib/docker
extraDetail.rationale: 除了审计普通的Linux文件系统和系统调用之外，还应该审计所有与Docker相关的文件和目录。Docker守护进程以根权限运行，其行为依赖于一些关键文件和目录。/var/lib/docker就是这样一个目录。由于它包含有关容器的所有信息，因此应该对其进行审计
extraDetail.audit:
您应该验证对/var/lib/docker目录应用了审计规则。例如，您可以执行以下命令:
auditctl -l | grep /var/lib/docker
这应该列出一个/var/lib/docker目录的规则
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该为/var/lib/docker目录添加一条规则,例如,
在/etc/audit/audit.rules文件中添加如下行:
-a exit,always -F path=/var/lib/docker -F perm=war -k docker
然后，使用以下命令重新启动审计守护进程
systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact: 审计可以生成较大的日志文件。您应该确保定期轮换和归档这些文件。还应该为审计日志创建一个单独的分区，以避免填充任何其他关键分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不审计Docker相关的文件和目录
extraDetail.description_en: Audit /var/lib/docker.
extraDetail.rationale_en: As well as auditing the normal Linux file system and system calls, you should also audit all Docker related files and directories. The Docker daemon runs with root privileges and its behaviour depends on some key files and directories. /var/lib/docker is one such directory. As it holds all the information about containers it should be audited.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should verify that there is an audit rule applied to the /var/lib/docker directory. For example, you could execute the command below: auditctl -l | grep /var/lib/docker  This should list a rule for the /var/lib/docker directory.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should add a rule for the /var/lib/docker directory. For example, Add the line as below to the /etc/audit/audit.rules file: -a exit,always -F path=/var/lib/docker -F perm=war -k docker Then, restart the audit daemon using the following command systemctl restart auditd 24 | Page
extraDetail.impact_en: Auditing can generate large log files. You should ensure that these are rotated and archived periodically. A separate partition should also be created for audit logs to avoid filling up any other critical partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker related files and directories are not audited.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure auditing is configured for Docker files and directories - /etc/docker
detail_zh: 确保为Docker文件和目录配置了审核-/ etc / docker

extraDetail.description: 审计/etc/docker
extraDetail.rationale: 除了审计普通的Linux文件系统和系统调用之外，还应该审计所有与Docker相关的文件和目录。Docker守护进程以根权限运行，它的行为依赖于一些关键文件和目录，其中之一就是/etc/docker。它保存着Docker守护进程和Docker客户机之间用于TLS通信的各种证书和密钥，因此应该对其进行审计
extraDetail.audit:
您应该验证是否有一个审计规则应用到/etc/docker目录。例如，您可以执行以下命令:
auditctl -l | grep /etc/docker
这将显示/etc/docker目录的规则
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该为/etc/docker目录添加一条规则,例如,
在/etc/audit/audit.rules文件中添加如下行:
-w /etc/docker -k docker
然后，使用以下命令重新启动审计守护进程
systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact: 审计可以生成较大的日志文件。您应该确保定期轮换和归档这些文件。还应该为审计日志创建一个单独的分区，以避免填充任何其他关键分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不审计Docker相关的文件和目录
extraDetail.description_en: Audit /etc/docker.
extraDetail.rationale_en: As well as auditing the normal Linux file system and system calls, you should also audit all Docker related files and directories. The Docker daemon runs with root privilege and its behavior depends on some key files and directories, one of these being /etc/docker. This holds various certificates and keys used for TLS communication between Docker daemon and Docker client and as such it should be audited.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should verify that there is an audit rule applied to the /etc/docker directory. For example, you could execute the command below: auditctl -l | grep /etc/docker  This should display a rule for the /etc/docker directory.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should add a rule for the /etc/docker directory. For example: Add the line below to the /etc/audit/audit.rules file: -w /etc/docker -k docker  Then restart the audit daemon. For example: systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact_en: Auditing can generate large log files. You should ensure that these are rotated and archived periodically. A separate partition should also be created for audit logs to avoid filling up any other critical partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker related files and directories are not audited.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure sshd is not run within containers
detail_zh: 确保sshd不在容器中运行,

extraDetail.description: SSH守护进程不应该在容器中运行。您应该SSH到Docker主机，并使用Docker exec进入容器
extraDetail.rationale:
在容器中运行SSH增加了安全管理的复杂性
•难以管理SSH服务器的访问策略和安全符合性
•难以跨不同容器管理密钥和密码
•SSH服务器安全升级管理困难
不使用SSH也可以通过shell访问容器，应该避免不必要地增加安全管理的复杂性
extraDetail.audit:
通过执行以下命令列出所有正在运行的容器实例:
docker ps --quiet
对于每个容器实例，执行以下命令:
docker exec <CONTAINER ID> ps -el
确保SSH服务器没有进程
extraDetail.remediation:
从容器中卸载SSH守护进程，并使用docker exec进入远程主机上的容器
docker exec --interactive --tty <CONTAINER ID> sh
或
docker attach <CONTAINER ID>
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，SSH服务器不在容器中运行。每个容器只允许一个进程
extraDetail.description_en: The SSH daemon should not be running within the container. You should SSH into the Docker host, and use docker exec to enter a container.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Running SSH within the container increases the complexity of security management by making it • Difficult to manage access policies and security compliance for SSH server • Difficult to manage keys and passwords across various containers • Difficult to manage security upgrades for SSH server It is possible to have shell access to a container without using SSH, the needlessly increasing the complexity of security management should be avoided.
extraDetail.audit_en: List all the running instances of containers by executing below command: docker ps --quiet  For each container instance, execute the below command: docker exec <CONTAINER ID> ps -el Ensure that there is no process for SSH server.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Uninstall the SSH daemon from the container and use and use docker exec to enter a container on the remote host. docker exec --interactive --tty <CONTAINER ID> sh OR docker attach <CONTAINER ID>
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, SSH server is not running inside the container. Only one process per container is allowed.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that docker exec commands are not used with the user=root option
detail_zh: 确保docker exec命令未与user = root选项一起使用,

extraDetail.description: 你不应该使用docker exec和——user=root选项
extraDetail.rationale:
在docker exec命令中使用——user=root选项，以根用户的身份在容器中执行它。这可能是不安全的，特别是在运行功能减少或限制增强的容器时
例如，如果您的容器以tomcat用户(或任何其他非root用户)的身份运行，则可以以root用户身份通过docker exec运行命令，并使用——user=root选项。这可能很危险
extraDetail.audit:
如果按照第1节的建议启用了审计，可以使用下面的命令过滤掉使用——user=root选项的docker exec命令
ausearch -k docker | grep exec | grep user
extraDetail.remediation: 你不应该在docker exec命令中使用——user=root选项
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，docker exec命令运行时不带——user选项
extraDetail.description_en: You should not use docker exec with the --user=root option.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Using the --user=root option in a docker exec command, executes it within the container as the root user. This could potentially be insecure, particularly when you are running containers with reduced capabilities or enhanced restrictions. For example, if your container is running as a tomcat user (or any other non-root user), it would be possible to run a command through docker exec as root with the --user=root option. This could potentially be dangerous.
extraDetail.audit_en: If you have auditing enabled as recommended in Section 1, you can use the command below to filter out docker exec commands that use the --user=root option. ausearch -k docker | grep exec | grep user
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not use the --user=root option in docker exec commands.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the docker exec command runs without the --user option.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that HEALTHCHECK instructions have been added to container images
detail_zh: 确保已将HEALTHCHECK指令添加到容器镜像中,

extraDetail.description: 您应该将HEALTHCHECK指令添加到Docker容器镜像中，以确保对正在运行的容器执行健康检查
extraDetail.rationale:
一个重要的安全控制是可用性控制。向容器镜像中添加HEALTHCHECK指令可以确保Docker引擎根据该指令定期检查正在运行的容器实例，以确保容器仍然是可操作的。
根据运行状况检查的结果，Docker引擎可以终止没有正确响应的容器，并实例化新的容器
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行下面的命令，以确保Docker镜像配置了适当的HEALTHCHECK指令
docker inspect --format='{{ .Config.Healthcheck }}' <IMAGE>
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该遵循Docker文档并重新构建容器镜像以包含HEALTHCHECK指令
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，没有配置HEALTHCHECK
extraDetail.description_en: You should add the HEALTHCHECK instruction to your Docker container images in order to ensure that health checks are executed against running containers.
extraDetail.rationale_en: An important security control is that of availability. Adding the HEALTHCHECK instruction to your container image ensures that the Docker engine periodically checks the running container instances against that instruction to ensure that containers are still operational. Based on the results of the health check, the Docker engine could terminate containers which are not responding correctly, and instantiate new ones.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below to ensure that Docker images have the appropriate HEALTHCHECK instruction configured. docker inspect --format='{{ .Config.Healthcheck }}' <IMAGE>
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should follow the Docker documentation and rebuild your container images to include the HEALTHCHECK instruction.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, HEALTHCHECK is not set.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure setuid and setgid permissions are removed
detail_zh: 确保已删除setuid和setgid权限,

extraDetail.description: 删除镜像中的setuid和setgid权限可以防止容器中的特权升级攻击
extraDetail.rationale: setuid和setgid权限可以用于权限升级。虽然这些权限有时是合法需要的，但您应该考虑从不需要它们的包中删除它们。应该对每个镜像进行检查
extraDetail.audit:
你应该对每个镜像运行下面的命令来列出具有setuid或setgid权限的可执行文件:
docker export <IMAGE ID> | tar -tv 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[-rwx].*(s|S).*\s[0-9]'
然后，您应该检查该列表，并确保所有配置了这些权限的可执行程序实际上都需要它们
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该只允许setuid和setgid权限用于需要它们的可执行文件。你可以在构建时通过在Dockerfile中添加以下命令来删除这些权限，最好是在Dockerfile的末尾:
RUN find / -perm /6000 -type f -exec chmod a-s {} \; || true
extraDetail.impact: 上面的命令将中断所有依赖于setuid或setgid权限的可执行文件，包括合法的。因此，您应该谨慎地修改该命令以适应您的需求，这样它就不会过度减少合法程序的权限。因此，在进行这种类型的修改之前，您应该保持一定程度的谨慎并仔细检查所有流程，以避免中断
extraDetail.description_en: Removing setuid and setgid permissions in the images can prevent privilege escalation attacks within containers.
extraDetail.rationale_en: setuid and setgid permissions can be used for privilege escalation. Whilst these permissions can on occasion be legitimately needed, you should consider removing them from packages which do not need them. This should be reviewed for each image.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below against each image to list the executables which have either setuid or setgid permissions: docker export <IMAGE ID> | tar -tv 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[-rwx].*(s|S).*\s[0-9]' You should then review the list and ensure that all executables configured with these permissions actually require them.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should allow setuid and setgid permissions only on executables which require them. You could remove these permissions at build time by adding the following command in your Dockerfile, preferably towards the end of the Dockerfile: RUN find / -perm /6000 -type f -exec chmod a-s {} \; || true  155 | Page
extraDetail.impact_en: The above command would break all executables that depend on setuid or setgid permissions including legitimate ones. You should therefore be careful to modify the command to suit your requirements so that it does not reduce the permissions of legitimate programs excessively. Because of this, you should exercise a degree of caution and examine all processes carefully before making this type of modification in order to avoid outages.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure only verified packages are installed
detail_zh: 确保仅安装已验证的软件包,

extraDetail.description: 在将软件包安装到镜像之前，您应该验证软件包的真实性
extraDetail.rationale: 验证软件包的真实性对于构建安全的容器镜像是必不可少的。来源不明的软件包可能是恶意的，或存在可能被利用的漏洞
extraDetail.audit:
运行下面的命令来获取镜像列表:
docker images
对上面列表中的每个镜像运行下面的命令，并检查如何确定包的真实性。这可以通过使用GPG密钥或其他安全的包分发机制实现
docker history <IMAGE ID>
或者，如果您可以访问镜像的Dockerfile，请验证包的真实性
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该使用您选择的安全软件包分发机制来确保软件包的真实性
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify the authenticity of packages before installing them into images.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Verifying authenticity of software packages is essential for building a secure container image. Packages with no known provenance could potentially be malicious or have vulnerabilities that could be exploited.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run the command below to get the list of images: docker images  Run the command below for each image in the list above, and check how the authenticity of the packages is being determined. This could be via the use of GPG keys or other secure package distribution mechanisms. docker history <IMAGE ID>  Alternatively, if you have access to Dockerfile for the image, verify that the authenticity of the packages is checked.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should use a secure package distribution mechanism of your choice to ensure the authenticity of software packages.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable

creator: default
detail_en: Images prepared for drift prevention
detail_zh: Images prepared for drift prevention, but in Chinese

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure images are scanned and rebuilt to include security patches
detail_zh: 确保扫描并重建镜像以包括安全补丁,

extraDetail.description: 应该经常扫描镜像以寻找任何漏洞。您应该重新构建所有镜像以包括这些补丁，然后从它们实例化新的容器
extraDetail.rationale:
漏洞是指黑客或恶意用户可以利用的漏洞或漏洞，而安全补丁是针对这些漏洞进行的更新。镜像漏洞扫描工具可用于查找镜像中的漏洞，然后检查可用的补丁以缓解这些漏洞。补丁会将系统更新到不包含这些问题的最新代码库，并且位于代码库的受支持版本上是非常重要的，因为供应商不倾向于为已经失去支持的旧版本提供补丁。应该在应用安全补丁之前进行评估，并且应该根据组织的IT安全策略来实施补丁
应该注意漏洞评估工具返回的结果，因为有些工具会简单地根据软件横幅返回结果，而这些结果可能并不完全准确
extraDetail.audit:
通过执行以下命令列出所有正在运行的容器实例:
docker ps --quiet
对于每个容器实例，使用容器中的包管理器(假设有一个可用的)来检查安全补丁的可用性
或者，运行镜像漏洞评估工具扫描环境中的所有镜像
extraDetail.remediation: 应该重新构建镜像，以确保使用基本镜像的最新版本，从而将操作系统补丁级别保持在适当的水平。重新构建镜像之后，应该使用更新的镜像重新启动容器
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器和镜像不会自动更新以解决缺少的操作系统安全补丁
extraDetail.description_en: Images should be scanned frequently for any vulnerabilities. You should rebuild all images to include these patches and then instantiate new containers from them.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Vulnerabilities are loopholes or bugs that can be exploited by hackers or malicious users, and security patches are updates to resolve these vulnerabilities. Image vulnerability scanning tools can be use to find vulnerabilities in images and then check for available patches to mitigate these. Patches update the system to a more recent code base which does not contain these problems, and being on a supported version of the code base is very important, as vendors do not tend to supply patches for older versions which have gone out of support. Security patches should be evaluated before applying and patching should be implemented in line with the organization's IT Security Policy. Care should be taken with the results returned by vulnerability assessment tools, as some will simply return results based on software banners, and these may not be entirely accurate.
extraDetail.audit_en: List all the running instances of containers by executing the command below: docker ps --quiet  For each container instance, use the package manager within the container (assuming there is one available) to check for the availability of security patches. Alternatively, run image vulnerability assessment tools to scan all the images in your environment.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Images should be re-built ensuring that the latest version of the base images are used, to keep the operating system patch level at an appropriate level. Once the images have been re-built, containers should be re-started making use of the updated images.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, containers and images are not updated automatically to address missing operating system security patches.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the 'on-failure' container restart policy is set to '5'
detail_zh: 确保将“失败时”容器重启策略设置为“ 5”,

extraDetail.description: 通过在docker run命令中使用——restart标志，您可以指定在退出时容器应该或不应该如何重新启动的重启策略。您应该选择on failure重启策略，并将重启尝试次数限制为5次
extraDetail.rationale: 如果您无限地尝试启动容器，可能会导致主机上的服务被拒绝。这可能是进行分布式拒绝服务攻击的一种简单方法，特别是在同一主机上有多个容器的情况下。此外，忽略容器的退出状态并总是试图重新启动容器，将导致不调查容器终止背后的根本原因。如果一个容器被终止，您应该调查它背后的原因，而不是试图无限期地重新启动它。您应该使用失败重新启动策略将容器重新启动的次数限制为最多5次
extraDetail.audit:
您应该使用下面的命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:RestartPolicyName={{ .HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name }} MaximumRetryCount={{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.MaximumRetryCount }}'
如果该命令返回RestartPolicyName=always，则表示系统没有达到最优配置
如果上面的命令返回RestartPolicyName=no或只是RestartPolicyName=，则重启策略没有被使用，容器将永远不会自动重新启动。虽然这可能是一个安全的选择，但从可用性的角度来看，这不是最好的选择
如果上面的命令返回RestartPolicyName=on-failure，那么通过查看MaximumRetryCount来验证重新启动尝试的次数设置为5或更少
extraDetail.remediation:
如果你希望一个容器被自动重启，一个示例命令如下:
docker run --detach --restart=on-failure:5 nginx
extraDetail.impact: 如果设置了这个选项，容器将只尝试重新启动自己5次
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器没有配置重启策略
extraDetail.description_en: By using the --restart flag in the docker run command you can specify a restart policy for how a container should or should not be restarted on exit. You should choose the on-failure restart policy and limit the restart attempts to 5.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If you indefinitely keep trying to start the container, it could possibly lead to a denial of service on the host. It could be an easy way to do a distributed denial of service attack especially if you have many containers on the same host. Additionally, ignoring the exit status of the container and always attempting to restart the container, leads to non-investigation of the root cause behind containers getting terminated. If a container gets terminated, you should investigate on the reason behind it instead of just attempting to restart it indefinitely. You should use the on-failure restart policy to limit the number of container restarts to a maximum of 5 attempts.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should use the command below docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: RestartPolicyName={{ .HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name }} MaximumRetryCount={{ .HostConfig.RestartPolicy.MaximumRetryCount }}' If this command returns RestartPolicyName=always, then the system is not configured optimally. If the above command returns RestartPolicyName=no or just RestartPolicyName=, then restart policies are not being used and the container would never be restarted automatically. Whilst this may be a secure option, it is not the best option from a usability standpoint. If the above command returns RestartPolicyName=on-failure, then verify that the number of restart attempts is set to 5 or less by looking at MaximumRetryCount.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If you wish a container to be automatically restarted, a sample command is as below: docker run --detach --restart=on-failure:5 nginx
extraDetail.impact_en: If this option is set, a container will only attempt to restart itself 5 times.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, containers are not configured with restart policies.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that image sprawl is avoided
detail_zh: 确保避免镜像蔓延

extraDetail.description: 您不应该在同一主机上保留大量的容器镜像。适当时只使用带标签的镜像
extraDetail.rationale: 如果您需要从生产中的“最新”版本退回到镜像的特定版本，那么标记镜像是很有用的。带有未使用或旧标签的镜像可能包含在实例化后可能被利用的漏洞
extraDetail.audit:
步骤1:通过执行以下命令，列出当前实例化的所有镜像id:
docker images --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Image={{.Config.Image }}'
步骤2:通过执行以下命令，列出系统中存在的所有镜像:
docker images
步骤3:比较步骤1和步骤2中的镜像id列表，查找当前未使用的镜像。如果发现任何未使用的或旧的镜像，请与系统管理员讨论是否需要在系统中保留这些镜像。如果镜像不再需要，就应该删除它们
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该只保留实际需要的镜像，并建立一个工作流来从主机中删除旧的或陈旧的镜像。此外，您应该使用诸如摘要拉取等功能从注册表中获取特定的镜像。
您可以按照以下步骤在系统上找到未使用的镜像，以便删除它们
步骤1:通过执行以下命令，列出当前实例化的所有镜像id:
docker images --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Image={{.Config.Image }}'
步骤2:通过执行以下命令，列出系统中存在的所有镜像:
docker images
步骤3:比较步骤1和步骤2中创建的镜像id列表，找出当前没有实例化的镜像
步骤4:决定是否要保留当前未使用的镜像。如果不需要，可以执行以下命令删除
docker rmi <IMAGE ID>
另外，可以使用docker system prune命令删除未标记的悬空镜像，或者(如果必要)删除与-a选项一起使用时当前未被运行的容器使用的所有镜像
extraDetail.impact: docker system prune -a删除所有退出的容器，以及所有未被运行中的容器引用的镜像和卷。如果任何镜像被删除，这将导致需要将镜像重新加载到主机
extraDetail.defaultValue: 在管理员删除引用这些镜像或层的所有标记之前，镜像和分层文件系统在主机上仍然可以访问

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the /etc/default/docker file ownership is set to root:root
detail_zh: 确保将/ etc / default / docker文件所有权设置为root：root,

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证/etc/default/docker文件的所有权和组所有权被正确设置为root
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/default/docker文件包含可能改变Docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该是由root单独拥有和组拥有的，以确保特权较低的用户不能修改它
extraDetail.audit:
你应该执行下面的命令来验证文件是由root单独拥有和组拥有的:
stat -c %U:%G /etc/default/docker | grep -v root:root
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chown root:root /etc/default/docker
extraDetail.defaultValue: 该文件可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the /etc/default/docker file ownership and group-ownership is correctly set to root.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The /etc/default/docker file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the Docker daemon. It should therefore be individually owned and group owned by root to ensure that it cannot be modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the file is individually owned and group owned by root: stat -c %U:%G /etc/default/docker | grep -v root:root  The command above should return no results.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command chown root:root /etc/default/docker This sets the ownership and group ownership of the file to root.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system, and in this case, this recommendation is not applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure Content trust for Docker is Enabled
detail_zh: 确保已启用对Docker的内容信任,

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，内容信任是禁用的，应该根据组织安全策略启用
extraDetail.rationale: 内容信任提供了对发送到远程Docker注册中心和从远程Docker注册中心接收的数据使用数字签名的能力。这些签名允许客户端验证特定镜像标记的标识和发布者，并确保容器镜像的来源
extraDetail.audit:
你应该执行下面的命令:
echo $DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST
这应该返回值为1
extraDetail.remediation:
要在bash shell中启用内容信任，您应该输入以下命令:
export DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1
或者，也可以在概要文件中设置此环境变量，以便每次登录时启用内容信任
extraDetail.impact:
在设置了DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST的环境中，在使用与镜像相关的命令(构建、创建、拉、推和运行)时，需要遵循信任过程。您可以在需要时使用——disable-content-trust标志在没有内容信任的标记镜像上运行单个操作，但这违背了启用内容信任的目的，因此应该尽可能避免
注意:内容信任目前仅对公共Docker Hub的用户可用。它目前不适用于Docker可信注册中心或私有注册中心
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未启用内容信任
extraDetail.description_en: Content trust is disabled by default and should be enabled in line with organizational security policy.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Content trust provides the ability to use digital signatures for data sent to and received from remote Docker registries. These signatures allow client-side verification of the identity and the publisher of specific image tags and ensures the provenance of container images.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the following command: echo $DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST  This should return a value of 1.
extraDetail.remediation_en: To enable content trust in a bash shell, you should enter the following command: export DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST=1 Alternatively, you could set this environment variable in your profile file so that content trust in enabled on every login. 149 | Page
extraDetail.impact_en: In an environment where DOCKER_CONTENT_TRUST is set, you are required to follow trust procedures whilst working with the image related commands - build, create, pull, push and run. You can use the --disable-content-trust flag to run individual operations on tagged images without content trust on an as needed basis, but this defeats the purpose of enabling content trust and therefore should be avoided wherever possible. Note: Content trust is currently only available for users of the public Docker Hub. It is currently not available for the Docker Trusted Registry or for private registries.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, content trust is disabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that node certificates are rotated as appropriate
detail_zh: 确保适当地轮换节点证书,

extraDetail.description: 您应该根据您的组织安全策略轮换群集节点证书
extraDetail.rationale: Docker Swarm使用TLS在节点之间进行集群操作。证书旋转可确保在发生节点或密钥受损等事件时，难以模拟节点。默认情况下，节点证书每90天轮换一次，但是您应该更频繁地轮换它们，或者在您的环境中根据情况进行轮换
extraDetail.audit:
运行下面的命令之一，并确保将节点证书的“过期时间”设置为适当的值
docker info | grep "Expiry Duration"
docker info --format 'NodeCertExpiry: {{.Swarm.Cluster.Spec.CAConfig.NodeCertExpiry }}'
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该运行该命令在节点证书上设置所需的过期时间。例如:
docker swarm update --cert-expiry 48h
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，节点证书每90天自动轮换一次
extraDetail.description_en: You should rotate swarm node certificates in line with your organizational security policy.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker Swarm uses TLS for clustering operations between its nodes. Certificate rotation ensures that in an event such as a compromised node or key, it is difficult to impersonate a node. By default, node certificates are rotated every 90 days, but you should rotate them more often or as appropriate in your environment.
extraDetail.audit_en: Run one of the commands below and ensure that the node certificate Expiry Duration is set as appropriate. docker info | grep "Expiry Duration" docker info --format 'NodeCertExpiry: {{ .Swarm.Cluster.Spec.CAConfig.NodeCertExpiry }}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the command to set the desired expiry time on the node certificate. For example: docker swarm update --cert-expiry 48h
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, node certificates are rotated automatically every 90 days.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that Docker commands always make use of the latest version of their image
detail_zh: 确保Docker命令始终使用其镜像的最新版本,

extraDetail.description: 您应该始终确保使用的是存储库中最新版本的镜像，而不是缓存的旧版本
extraDetail.rationale: 多个Docker命令，如Docker pull、Docker run等都有已知的问题，在默认情况下，它们提取镜像的本地副本(如果存在的话)，即使上游存储库中存在具有相同标记的更新版本的镜像。这可能导致使用包含已知漏洞的旧镜像
extraDetail.audit:
你应该执行以下步骤:
步骤1:打开镜像存储库，列出正在检查的镜像的镜像版本历史记录
步骤2:观察触发docker pull命令时的状态。如果状态显示为Image is up to date，这意味着您正在获取镜像的缓存版本
步骤3:将正在运行的镜像版本与存储库中报告的最新版本相匹配，这将告诉您运行的是缓存版本还是最新副本
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该使用适当的版本固定机制(默认情况下分配的“最新”标签仍然容易受到缓存攻击)，以避免提取缓存的旧版本。版本固定机制应该用于基本镜像、包和整个镜像。您可以根据需要定制版本固定规则
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker命令提取本地副本，除非使用版本固定机制或清除本地缓存
extraDetail.description_en: You should always ensure that you are using the latest version of the images within your repository and not cached older versions.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Multiple Docker commands such as docker pull, docker run etc. are known to have an issue where by default, they extract the local copy of the image, if present, even though there is an updated version of the image with the same tag in the upstream repository. This could lead to using older images containing known vulnerabilites.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should carry out the following steps: Step 1: Open your image repository and list the image version history for the image you are inspecting. Step 2: Observe the status when the docker pull command is triggered. If the status is shown as Image is up to date, it means that you are getting the cached version of the image. Step 3: Match the version of the image you are running to the latest version reported in your repository and this will tell you whether you are running the cached version or the latest copy.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should use proper version pinning mechanisms (the "latest" tag which is assigned by default is still vulnerable to caching attacks) to avoid extracting cached older versions. Version pinning mechanisms should be used for base images, packages, and entire images. You can customize version pinning rules according to your requirements.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker commands extract the local copy unless version pinning mechanisms are used or the local cache is cleared.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure insecure registries are not used (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保不使用不安全的注册表(自动)

extraDetail.description: Docker认为私有注册表是安全的还是不安全的。默认情况下，注册中心被认为是安全的
extraDetail.rationale:
安全注册中心使用TLS。注册中心的CA证书副本放在Docker主机的/etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name>/目录。不安全的注册中心是没有有效注册中心证书的注册中心，或者不使用TLS的注册中心。不安全的注册中心不应该被使用，因为它们存在流量被拦截和修改的风险
此外，一旦注册表被标记为不安全的命令，如docker pull、docker push和docker search将不会导致错误消息，用户可能会无限期地使用这种类型的不安全注册表，而从未被通知潜在的风险
extraDetail.audit:
你应该执行下面的命令来找出是否有不安全的注册表正在使用:
docker info --format 'Insecure Registries:{{.RegistryConfig.InsecureRegistryCIDRs}}'
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该确保没有使用不安全的注册中心
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker假定除了本地之外的所有注册中心都是安全的
extraDetail.description_en: Docker considers a private registry either secure or insecure. By default, registries are considered secure.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A secure registry uses TLS. A copy of registry's CA certificate is placed on the Docker host at /etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name>/ directory. An insecure registry is one which does not have a valid registry certificate, or one not not using TLS. Insecure registries should not be used as they present a risk of traffic interception and modification. Additionally, once a registry has been marked as insecure commands such as docker pull, docker push, and docker search will not result in an error message and users may indefinitely be working with this type of insecure registry without ever being notified of the risk of potential compromise.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to find out if any insecure registries are in use: docker info --format 'Insecure Registries: {{.RegistryConfig.InsecureRegistryCIDRs}}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should ensure that no insecure registries are in use.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that unnecessary packages are not installed in the container (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保容器中未安装不必要的软件包（手动）

extraDetail.description: 容器应该有尽可能小的空间，并且不应该包含可能增加攻击面的不必要的软件包
extraDetail.rationale: 不应该在容器中安装不必要的软件，因为这样做会增加容器的攻击面。只应该安装对所部署的应用程序的正确操作严格必需的软件包
extraDetail.audit:
通过执行以下命令列出所有正在运行的容器实例:
docker ps --quiet
对于每个容器实例，执行相关的命令列出所有已安装的包，例如:
docker exec $INSTANCE_ID rpm -qa
上面的命令列出了已安装的包。您应该检查列表，并确保安装的所有东西都是实际需要的
extraDetail.remediation:
您不应该在容器中安装任何不需要的东西。
如果可以的话，应该考虑使用最小的基本镜像，而不是标准的Centos、Debian或Red Hat镜像。一些可用的选项包括BusyBox和Alpine。这不仅可以大幅缩减镜像大小，而且还可以减少包含攻击向量的软件片段
extraDetail.description_en: Containers should have as small a footprint as possible, and should not contain unnecessary software packages which could increase their attack surface.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Unnecessary software should not be installed into containers, as doing so increases their attack surface. Only packages strictly necessary for the correct operation of the application being deployed should be installed.
extraDetail.audit_en: List all the running instances of containers by executing the command below: docker ps --quiet For each container instance, execute the relevant command for listing all installed packages, e.g.: docker exec $INSTANCE_ID rpm -qa The command above lists the packages installed. You should review the list and ensure that everything installed is actually required.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not install anything within the container that is not required. You should consider using a minimal base image rather than the standard Centos, Debian, or Red Hat images if you can. Some of the options available include BusyBox and Alpine. Not only can this trim your image size considerably, but there would also be fewer pieces of software which could contain vectors for attack. 145 | Page
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the host's IPC namespace is not shared (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保不共享主机的IPC名称空间（自动）

extraDetail.description: IPC (POSIX/SysV IPC)命名空间提供命名共享内存段、信号量和消息队列的分离。因此，主机上的IPC名称空间不应该与容器共享，应该保持隔离
extraDetail.rationale: IPC命名空间提供了主机和容器之间的IPC分离。如果主机的IPC命名空间与容器共享，它将允许容器内的进程查看主机系统上的所有IPC通信。这将消除主机和容器之间IPC级别隔离的好处。具有容器访问权限的攻击者可以在此级别访问主机，并造成严重后果。因此，IPC名称空间不应该在主机及其容器之间共享
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:IpcMode={{ .HostConfig.IpcMode }}'
如果该命令返回host，则意味着主机IPC命名空间与容器共享。任何其他结果都意味着它不是共享的，因此系统的配置符合良好的安全实践
extraDetail.remediation:
不应该使用——ipc=host参数启动容器。例如，不要像下面这样启动一个容器:
docker run --interactive --tty --ipc=host centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact:
使用共享内存段是为了加速进程间通信，通常在高性能应用程序中。如果这种类型的应用程序被装入多个容器中，您可能需要共享容器的IPC名称空间，以实现高性能。在这些情况下，仍然应该只共享特定于容器的IPC名称空间，而不共享主机IPC名称空间
一个容器的IPC命名空间可以与另一个容器共享，如下所示:
docker run --interactive --tty --ipc=container:e3a7a1a97c58 centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，所有容器都启用了它们的IPC命名空间，主机IPC命名空间不与任何容器共享
extraDetail.description_en: IPC (POSIX/SysV IPC) namespace provides separation of named shared memory segments, semaphores and message queues. The IPC namespace on the host should therefore not be shared with containers and should remain isolated.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The IPC namespace provides separation of IPC between the host and containers. If the host's IPC namespace is shared with the container, it would allow processes within the container to see all of IPC communications on the host system. This would remove the benefit of IPC level isolation between host and containers. An attacker with access to a container could get access to the host at this level with major consequences. The IPC namespace should therefore not be shared between the host and its containers.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: IpcMode={{ .HostConfig.IpcMode }}' If the command returns host, it means that the host IPC namespace is shared with the container. Any other result means that it is not shared, and that the system is therefore configured in line with good security practice. 196 | Page
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not start a container with the --ipc=host argument. For example, do not start a container as below: docker run --interactive --tty --ipc=host centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact_en: Shared memory segments are used in order to accelerate interprocess communications, commonly in high-performance applications. If this type of application is containerized into multiple containers, you might need to share the IPC namespace of the containers in order to achieve high performance. Under these circumstances, you should still only share container specific IPC namespaces and not the host IPC namespace. A container's IPC namespace can be shared with another container as shown below: docker run --interactive --tty --ipc=container:e3a7a1a97c58 centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all containers have their IPC namespace enabled and host IPC namespace is not shared with any container.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the host's UTS namespace is not shared (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保不共享主机的UTS名称空间（自动）

extraDetail.description: UTS名称空间提供了两个系统标识符之间的隔离:主机名和NIS域名。它用于设置该名称空间中正在运行的进程可见的主机名和域。在容器中运行的进程通常不需要知道主机名或域名。因此，不应该与主机共享UTS名称空间
extraDetail.rationale: 与主机共享UTS名称空间为每个容器提供了更改主机主机名的完全权限。这与良好的安全实践不一致，不应该被允许
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:UTSMode={{ .HostConfig.UTSMode }}'
如果上面的命令返回host，则意味着主机UTS名称空间与容器共享，并且这个建议是不符合的。如果上面的命令没有返回任何东西，那么就没有共享主机的UTS名称空间。这个建议是符合的
extraDetail.remediation:
你不应该用——uts=host参数启动一个容器。例如，不要使用下面的命令启动一个容器:
docker run --rm --interactive --tty --uts=host rhel7.2
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，所有容器都启用了UTS名称空间，主机UTS名称空间不与任何容器共享
extraDetail.description_en: UTS namespaces provide isolation between two system identifiers: the hostname and the NIS domain name. It is used to set the hostname and the domain which are visible to running processes in that namespace. Processes running within containers do not typically require to know either the hostname or the domain name. The UTS namespace should therefore not be shared with the host.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Sharing the UTS namespace with the host provides full permission for each container to change the hostname of the host. This is not in line with good security practice and should not be permitted.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: UTSMode={{ .HostConfig.UTSMode }}'  If the above command returns host, it means the host UTS namespace is shared with the container and this recommendation is non-compliant. If the above command returns nothing, then the host's UTS namespace is not shared. This recommendation is then compliant.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not start a container with the --uts=host argument. For example, do not start a container using the command below: docker run --rm --interactive --tty --uts=host rhel7.2
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all containers have the UTS namespace enabled and the host UTS namespace is not shared with any containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure swarm mode is not Enabled, if not needed (Automated)
detail_zh: 如果不需要，确保群模式未启用（自动）

extraDetail.description: 除非需要，否则不要在Docker引擎实例上启用群集模式
extraDetail.rationale:
默认情况下，Docker引擎实例不会监听任何网口，与客户机的所有通信都通过Unix套接字进行。当Docker引擎实例启用Docker集群模式时，系统会打开多个网口，供网络上的其他系统使用，用于集群管理和节点通信

需要注意的是，Docker Enterprise组件的操作需要集群模式
extraDetail.audit:

docker info --format '{{ .Swarm }}'
如果输出包含active true，则表示Docker引擎已激活了群集模式。在这种情况下，您应该确认Docker引擎实例上的群集模式是否真的需要
extraDetail.remediation:
如果在错误的系统上开启了swarm模式，您应该执行以下命令:
docker swarm leave
extraDetail.impact: 禁用集群模式会影响Docker Enterprise组件的运行
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，没有启用Docker集群模式

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the Docker server certificate file permissions are set to 444 or more restrictively (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将Docker服务器证书文件权限限制严格地设置为444或更高（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证Docker服务器证书文件(与——tlscert参数一起传递的文件)是否具有444或更严格的权限
extraDetail.rationale: Docker服务器证书文件应该受到保护，不受任何篡改。它用于基于给定的服务器证书对Docker服务器进行身份验证。因此，它应该具有444的权限，以防止对其进行修改
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证Docker服务器证书文件具有444或更严格的权限:
stat -c %a <path to Docker server certificate file>
如果输出包含active true，则表示Docker引擎已激活了群集模式。在这种情况下，您应该确认Docker引擎实例上的群集模式是否真的需要
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chmod 444 <path to Docker server certificate file>
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker服务器证书文件的权限可能不是444。默认的文件权限由操作系统或用户特定的umask值控制
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the Docker server certificate file (the file that is passed along with the --tlscert parameter) has permissions of 444 or more restrictive permissions.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Docker server certificate file should be protected from any tampering. It is used to authenticate the Docker server based on the given server certificate. It should therefore have permissions of 444 to prevent its modification.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the Docker server certificate file has permissions of 444 or more restrictive permissions: stat -c %a <path to Docker server certificate file>
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the command below: chmod 444 <path to Docker server certificate file> This sets the file permissions of the Docker server certificate file to 444.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the permissions for the Docker server certificate file might not be 444. The default file permissions are governed by the operating system or user specific umask values.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure mount propagation mode is not set to shared (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保未将挂载传播模式设置为共享（自动）

extraDetail.description: 挂载传播模式允许在容器上以共享、从或私有模式挂载卷。除非明确需要，否则不要使用共享挂载传播模式
extraDetail.rationale:
在所有挂载上复制共享挂载，在任何挂载点上所做的更改将传播到所有其他挂载点
以共享模式挂载卷不会限制任何其他容器挂载和更改该卷
因为从安全性的角度来看，这可能不是一个理想的选项，所以除非明确要求，否则不应该使用该特性
extraDetail.audit:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:Propagation={{range $mnt := .Mounts}} {{json $mnt.Propagation}} {{end}}'
上面的命令返回挂载卷的传播模式。除非需要，否则不应将传播模式设置为共享。如果没有挂载，上面的命令可能会抛出错误。在这种情况下，本建议不适用
extraDetail.remediation:
不要在共享模式传播中挂载卷。例如，不要像下面这样启动一个容器:
docker run <Run arguments> --volume=/hostPath:/containerPath:shared <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器挂载是私有的
extraDetail.description_en: Mount propagation mode allows mounting volumes in shared, slave or private mode on a container. Do not use shared mount propagation mode unless explicitly needed.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A shared mount is replicated at all mounts and changes made at any mount point are propagated to all other mount points. Mounting a volume in shared mode does not restrict any other container from mounting and making changes to that volume. As this is likely not a desirable option from a security standpoint, this feature should not be used unless explicitly required.
extraDetail.audit_en: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Propagation={{range $mnt := .Mounts}} {{json $mnt.Propagation}} {{end}}' The above command returns the propagation mode for mounted volumes. The propagation mode should not be set to shared unless needed. The above command might throw errors if there are no mounts. In that case, this recommendation is not applicable.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Do not mount volumes in shared mode propagation. For example, do not start a container as below: docker run <Run arguments> --volume=/hostPath:/containerPath:shared <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the container mounts are private. 203 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the Docker socket file ownership is set to root:docker (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将Docker套接字文件所有权设置为root：docker（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证Docker套接字文件由root拥有，组由docker拥有
extraDetail.rationale:
Docker守护进程以root运行。因此，默认的Unix套接字必须由root拥有。如果任何其他用户或进程拥有这个套接字，那么这个非特权用户或进程就有可能与Docker守护进程交互。此外，在这种情况下，非特权用户或进程可能能够与容器交互，这既不是安全的，也不是理想的行为
此外，Docker安装程序会创建一个名为docker的Unix组。您可以将用户添加到这个组中，在这种情况下，这些用户将能够读写默认的Docker Unix套接字。docker组的成员资格由系统管理员严格控制。但是，如果任何其他组拥有这个套接字，那么该组的成员就有可能与Docker守护进程交互。这样的组可能不像docker组那样受到严格控制。同样，这也不符合良好的安全实践
由于这些原因，默认的Docker Unix套接字文件应该由root和docker拥有的组来维护套接字文件的完整性
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证Docker套接字文件是由root和docker拥有的组:
stat -c %U:%G /var/run/docker.sock | grep -v root:docker
上面的命令应该不返回任何结果
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chown root:docker /var/run/docker.sock
这将默认docker套接字文件的所有权设置为root，并将组所有权设置为docker
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker套接字文件的所有权和组所有权被正确设置为root:docker
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the Docker socket file is owned by root and group owned by docker.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Docker daemon runs as root. The default Unix socket therefore must be owned by root. If any other user or process owns this socket, it might be possible for that non-privileged user or process to interact with the Docker daemon. Additionally, in this case a non-privileged user or process might be able to interact with containers which is neither a secure nor desired behavior. Additionally, the Docker installer creates a Unix group called docker. You can add users to this group, and in this case, those users would be able to read and write to the default Docker Unix socket. The membership of the docker group is tightly controlled by the system administrator. However, ff any other group owns this socket, then it might be possible for members of that group to interact with the Docker daemon. Such a group might not be as tightly controlled as the docker group. Again, this is not in line with good security practice. For these reason, the default Docker Unix socket file should be owned by root and group owned by docker to maintain the integrity of the socket file.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the below command to verify that the Docker socket file is owned by root and group owned by docker: stat -c %U:%G /var/run/docker.sock | grep -v root:docker The command above should return no results.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chown root:docker /var/run/docker.sock This sets the ownership to root and group ownership to docker for the default Docker socket file.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the ownership and group ownership for the Docker socket file is correctly set to root:docker.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure containers are restricted from acquiring new privileges (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保限制容器获取新特权（自动）

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，应该限制容器通过suid或sgid获得额外的特权
extraDetail.rationale:
进程可以在内核中设置no_new_priv位，这将在fork、克隆和execve中持续存在。no_new_priv位确保进程及其子进程不会通过suid或sgid位获得任何额外的特权。这降低了与许多危险操作相关的安全风险，因为破坏特权二进制文件的能力大大降低了
在守护进程级别设置此设置可确保在默认情况下限制所有新容器获取新特权
extraDetail.audit:
要确认这个设置，您应该检查dockerd启动选项，并检查/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置。
要查看dockerd启动选项，可以使用以下命令:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
您应该确保存在——no-new-privileges参数，并且它没有被设置为false
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation:
你应该像下面这样运行Docker守护进程:
dockerd --no-new-privileges
extraDetail.impact: no_new_priv防止lsm(例如SELinux)升级个别容器的特权
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不限制容器获取新的特权
extraDetail.description_en: By default you should restrict containers from acquiring additional privileges via suid or sgid.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A process can set the no_new_priv bit in the kernel and this persists across forks, clones and execve. The no_new_priv bit ensures that the process and its child processes do not gain any additional privileges via suid or sgid bits. This reduces the security risks associated with many dangerous operations because there is a much reduced ability to subvert privileged binaries. Setting this at the daemon level ensures that by default all new containers are restricted from acquiring new privileges.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting, you should review the dockerd start-up options and a check of any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be carried out. To review the dockerd startup options, the following command can be used: ps -ef | grep dockerd  You should ensure that the --no-new-privileges parameter is present and that it is not set to false. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the Docker daemon as below: dockerd --no-new-privileges
extraDetail.impact_en: no_new_priv prevents LSMs such as SELinux from escalating the privileges of individual containers.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, containers are not restricted from acquiring new privileges.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that registry certificate file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保注册表证书文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证所有注册表证书文件(通常在/etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name>目录下)都是由root单独拥有和组拥有的
extraDetail.rationale: /etc/docker/certs.d/<registry-name>目录包含Docker注册表证书。这些证书文件必须是根用户单独拥有和组拥有的，以确保特权较低的用户无法修改目录的内容
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证注册表证书文件是由root单独拥有和组拥有的:
stat -c %U:%G /etc/docker/certs.d/* | grep -v root:root
上面的命令不应该返回任何值

detail_en: Ensure aufs storage driver is not used (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保未使用aufs存储驱动程序（自动）

extraDetail.description: 不要使用aufs作为Docker实例的存储驱动程序
extraDetail.rationale:
aufs存储驱动程序是Linux系统中最古老的存储驱动程序。它基于Linux内核补丁集，将来不太可能合并到主操作系统内核中。众所周知，aufs驱动程序还会导致一些严重的内核崩溃。aufs只在使用Docker的系统中提供遗留支持
最重要的是，aufs在许多使用最新Linux内核的Linux发行版中都不受支持，而且在Docker Engine发行版20.10中也已弃用
extraDetail.audit:
执行以下命令，检查是否使用aufs作为存储驱动程序:
docker info --format 'Storage Driver: {{ .Driver }}'
上面的命令不应该返回aufs
extraDetail.remediation:
不要显式地使用aufs作为存储驱动程序。
例如，不启动Docker守护进程如下:
dockerd --storage-driver aufs
extraDetail.impact: aufs是唯一允许容器共享可执行文件和共享库内存的存储驱动程序。如果您正在使用相同的程序或库运行数千个容器，那么它可能会很有用，但是应该根据组织的安全策略审查它的使用
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker在大多数平台上使用overlay2作为存储驱动程序。默认的存储驱动程序可能因操作系统厂商而异。您应该使用首选供应商推荐的存储驱动程序，并且该驱动程序符合所部署应用程序的相关策略
extraDetail.description_en: Do not use aufs as the storage driver for your Docker instance.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The aufs storage driver is the oldest storage driver used on Linux systems. It is based on a Linux kernel patch-set that is unlikely in future to be merged into the main OS kernel. The aufs driver is also known to cause some serious kernel crashes. aufs only has legacy support within systems using Docker. Most importantly, aufs is not a supported driver in many Linux distributions using latest Linux kernels and has also been deprecated with Docker Engine release 20.10.
extraDetail.audit_en: Execute the below command and verify that aufs is not used as storage driver: docker info --format 'Storage Driver: {{ .Driver }}' The above command should not return aufs.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Do not explicitly use aufs as storage driver. For example, do not start Docker daemon as below: dockerd --storage-driver aufs
extraDetail.impact_en: aufs is the only storage driver that allows containers to share executable and shared library memory. It might be useful if you are running thousands of containers with the same program or libraries, however its use should be reviewed in line with your organization's security policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker uses overlay2 as the storage driver on most of the platforms. The default storage driver can vary based on your OS vendor. You should use the storage driver that is recommended by your preferred vendor and which is in line with policy around the applications which are being deployed.

detail_en: Ensure that only needed ports are open on the container(Manual)
detail_zh: 确保仅在容器上打开了需要的端口（手动）

extraDetail.description: 容器镜像的dockerfile定义了在容器实例上默认打开的端口。端口列表与您在容器中运行的应用程序相关，只有在需要时才应该打开它们
extraDetail.rationale: 容器可以只使用Dockerfile中为其镜像定义的端口运行，也可以任意传递运行时参数以打开端口列表。此外,在时间的推移,Dockerfile可能经历的各种变化和暴露端口的列表可能或不可能仍然是相关的容器内运行的应用程序。打开不需要的端口会增加容器和相关的容器化应用程序的攻击面。良好的安全实践是只打开应用程序正确操作所需的端口
extraDetail.audit:
你应该通过执行下面的命令列出所有正在运行的容器实例和它们关联的端口映射:
docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Ports={{.NetworkSettings.Ports }}'
然后应该检查列表，确保映射的所有端口实际上都是每个容器真正需要的
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该确保每个容器镜像的Dockerfile只公开所需的端口。你也可以通过在启动容器时不使用-P(大写)或——publish-all标志来完全忽略Dockerfile中定义的端口列表。相反，使用-p(小写)或——publish标志显式定义特定容器实例所需的端口，例如:
docker run --interactive --tty --publish 5000 --publish 5001 --publish 5002 centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，当容器以-P或——publish-all标志运行时，将打开Dockerfile中image的EXPOSE指令下列出的所有端口
extraDetail.description_en: The dockerfile for a container image defines the ports which are opened by default on a container instance. The list of ports are relevant to the application you are running within the container and should only be open if they are needed.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A container can be run with only the ports defined in the Dockerfile for its image or can alternatively be arbitrarily passed run time parameters to open a list of ports. Additionally, in the course of time, the Dockerfile may undergo various changes and the list of exposed ports may or may not still be relevant to the application you are running within the container. Opening unneeded ports increases the attack surface of the container and the associated containerized application. Good security practice is to only open ports that are needed for the correct operation of the application.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should list all the running instances of containers and their associated port mappings by executing the command below: docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Ports={{ .NetworkSettings.Ports }}' You should then review the list and ensure that all the ports mapped are in fact genuinely required by each container.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should ensure that the Dockerfile for each container image only exposes needed ports. You can also completely ignore the list of ports defined in the Dockerfile by NOT using -P (UPPERCASE) or the --publish-all flag when starting the container. Instead, use the -p (lowercase) or --publish flag to explicitly define the ports that you need for a particular container instance. For example: docker run --interactive --tty --publish 5000 --publish 5001 --publish 5002 centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all the ports that are listed in the Dockerfile under the EXPOSE instruction for an image are opened when a container is run with the -P or --publish-all flags.

detail_en: Ensure that Docker's default bridge docker0 is not used (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保未使用Docker的默认网桥docker0（手动）

extraDetail.description: 你不应该使用Docker的默认桥docker0。相反，您应该使用Docker的用户定义网络进行容器联网
extraDetail.rationale: Docker将以网桥模式创建的虚拟接口连接到一个名为docker0的公共网桥。这种默认的组网模式由于没有应用过滤，很容易受到ARP欺骗和MAC泛洪攻击
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行下面的命令，并验证容器位于用户定义的网络上，而不是默认的docker0网桥上

extraDetail.remediation: 您应该按照Docker文档设置用户定义的网络。所有的容器都应该在这个网络中运行
extraDetail.impact: 用户自定义网络需要根据组织安全策略进行配置和管理
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker在默认的docker0桥中运行容器
extraDetail.description_en: You should not use Docker's default bridge docker0. Instead you should use Docker's user-defined networks for container networking.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker connects virtual interfaces created in bridge mode to a common bridge called docker0. This default networking model is vulnerable to ARP spoofing and MAC flooding attacks as there is no filtering applied to it.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below, and verify that containers are on a user-defined network and not the default docker0 bridge. docker network ls --quiet | xargs docker network inspect --format '{{ .Name }}: {{ .Options }}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should follow the Docker documentation and set up a user-defined network. All the containers should be run in this network.
extraDetail.impact_en: User-defined networks need to be configured and managed in line with organizational security policy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker runs containers within the default docker0 bridge.

chmod 444 <path to TLS CA certificate file>

extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the TLS CA certificate file (the file that is passed along with the --tlscacert parameter) has permissions of 444 or is set more restrictively.

extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the TLS CA certificate file has permissions of 444 or that these are more restrictively set: stat -c %a <path to TLS CA certificate file>

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that, if applicable, SELinux security options are set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保设置了SELinux安全选项（自动）

extraDetail.description: SELinux是一个有效的、易于使用的Linux应用程序安全系统。它在Red Hat和Fedora等某些发行版上默认可用
extraDetail.rationale: SELinux提供了一个强制访问控制(MAC)系统，它极大地增强了默认的任意访问控制(DAC)模型。因此，通过在Linux主机上启用SELinux，可以为容器添加额外的安全层
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:SecurityOpt={{ .HostConfig.SecurityOpt }} MountLabel={{ .MountLabel }} ProcessLabel={{ .ProcessLabel }}'
此命令返回列出的容器上当前配置的所有安全选项。注意，即使返回空的SecurityOpt, MountLabel和ProcessLabel值也将指示是否正在使用SELinux
extraDetail.remediation:
如果SELinux适用于您的Linux操作系统，您应该使用它
1. 设置SELinux状态
2. 设置SELinux策略
3.为Docker容器创建或导入SELinux策略模板
4. 在启用SELinux的守护程序模式下启动Docker。例如:
docker daemon --selinux-enabled
或者在daemon.json配置文件中添加以下内容:{"selinux-enabled": true}
5. 使用安全选项启动Docker容器。例如,
docker run --interactive --tty --security-opt label=level:TopSecret centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact: SELinux策略中定义的任何限制都将应用于您的容器。应该注意的是，如果您的SELinux策略配置错误，这可能会影响受影响容器的正确操作
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器上不应用SELinux安全选项
extraDetail.description_en: SELinux is an effective and easy-to-use Linux application security system. It is available by default on some distributions such as Red Hat and Fedora.
extraDetail.rationale_en: SELinux provides a Mandatory Access Control (MAC) system that greatly augments the default Discretionary Access Control (DAC) model. You can therefore add an extra layer of safety to your containers by enabling SELinux on your Linux host.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: SecurityOpt={{ .HostConfig.SecurityOpt }} MountLabel={{ .MountLabel }} ProcessLabel={{ .ProcessLabel }}' This command returns all the security options currently configured on the containers listed. Note that even if an empty SecurityOpt is returned, the MountLabel and ProcessLabel values will indicate if SELinux is in use.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If SELinux is applicable for your Linux OS, you should use it. 1. Set the SELinux State. 2. Set the SELinux Policy. 3. Create or import a SELinux policy template for Docker containers. 4. Start Docker in daemon mode with SELinux enabled. For example: docker daemon --selinux-enabled or by adding the following to the daemon.json configuration file: {   "selinux-enabled": true }  5. Start your Docker container using the security options. For example, docker run --interactive --tty --security-opt label=level:TopSecret centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact_en: Any restrictions defined in the SELinux policy will be applied to your containers. It should be noted that if your SELinux policy is misconfigured, this may have an impact on the correct operation of the affected containers.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, no SELinux security options are applied on containers.

detail_en: Ensure that the version of Docker is up to date (Manual)
