extraDetail.description: Docker的频繁发布解决了安全漏洞，解决了产品bug，并带来了新的功能。您应该密切关注这些产品更新，并根据组织的一般IT安全策略尽可能频繁地进行升级
extraDetail.rationale: 通过及时更新Docker，可以缓解软件中的漏洞。经验丰富的攻击者可能会利用已知的漏洞，从而获得不适当的访问或提升他们的特权。如果您不能确保Docker运行在与您的应用程序的要求一致的最新版本，您可能会引入不必要的行为，因此，确保您监控软件版本并及时升级是很重要的
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行下面的命令，以验证Docker版本是否符合您正在运行的应用程序的要求。应该注意的是，如果您正在使用的版本不包含任何关键的或高安全性的漏洞，那么使用最新的版本并不是安全需求
docker version
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该监视Docker版本的发布，并确保您的软件按要求进行了更新
extraDetail.impact: 您应该对Docker版本更新进行风险评估，并审查它们可能如何影响您的操作。您应该意识到，使用Docker的第三方产品可能需要支持较老的主要Docker版本，这应该根据您组织的通用IT安全政策进行审查，特别是在较老版本的安全漏洞已经公开披露的情况下
extraDetail.description_en: Frequent releases for Docker are issued which address security vulnerabilities, resolve product bugs and bring in new functionality. You should keep a tab on these product updates and upgrade as frequently as possible in line with the general IT security policy of your organization.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By staying up to date on Docker updates, vulnerabilities in the software can be mitigated. An experienced attacker may be able to exploit known vulnerabilities resulting in them being able to attain inappropriate access or to elevate their privileges. If you do not ensure that Docker is running at the most current release consistent with the requirements of of your application, you may introduce unwanted behaviour and it is therefore important to ensure that you monitor software versions and upgrade in a timely fashion.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below in order to verify that the Docker version is up to date in line with the requirements of the application you are running. It should be noted that it is not a security requirement to be at the most up to date version, provided the version you are using does not contain any critical or high security vulnerabilities. docker version
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should monitor versions of Docker releases and make sure your software is updated as required. 54 | Page
extraDetail.impact_en: You should perform a risk assessment regarding Docker version updates and review how they may impact your operations. You should be aware that third-party products that use Docker may require older major versions of Docker to be supported, and this should be reviewed in line with the general IT security policy of your organization, particularly where security vulnerabilities in older versions have been publicly disclosed.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure auditing is configured for Docker files and directories - docker.socket (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保为Docker文件和目录配置了审核-docker.socket（自动）

extraDetail.description: 如果适用，审计docker.socket
extraDetail.rationale: 除了审计普通的Linux文件系统和系统调用之外，还应该审计Docker守护进程。因为这个守护进程使用根特权运行，所以审计它的活动和使用是非常重要的。它的行为依赖于一些关键文件和目录，docker.socket就是其中一个这样的文件，因为它包含Docker守护进程的各种参数，所以应该对它进行审计
extraDetail.audit:
步骤1:找出配置文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket
步骤2:定位套接字文件的位置:
grep ListenStream <FragmentPath from previous step>
步骤3:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果该文件存在，您应该验证是否存在与该文件对应的审计规则:
例如，您可以执行以下命令:
auditctl -l | grep docker.socket
这应该显示docker.socket的规则
extraDetail.remediation:
如果文件存在，您应该为它添加一个规则,例如:
将以下行添加到/etc/audit/audit.rules文件中:
-w /var/run/docker.sock -k docker
然后，使用以下命令重新启动审计守护进程
systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact: 审计可以生成较大的日志文件。您应该确保定期轮换和归档这些文件。还应该为审计日志创建一个单独的分区，以避免填充任何其他关键分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不审计Docker相关的文件和目录。docker.socket文件可能不存在，但如果存在，则应该对其进行审计
extraDetail.description_en: Audit docker.socket, if applicable.
extraDetail.rationale_en: As well as auditing the normal Linux file system and system calls, you should also audit the Docker daemon. Because this daemon runs with root privileges, it is very important to audit its activities and usage. Its behavior depends on some key files and directories with docker.socket being one such file, and as this holds various parameters for the Docker daemon, it should be audited.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1: Find out the configuration file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket Step 2: Locate the socket file location: grep ListenStream <FragmentPath from previous step> Step 3: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file exists, you should verify that there is an audit rule corresponding to the file: For example, you could execute the command below: auditctl -l | grep docker.socket This should display a rule for docker.socket.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If the file exists, you should add a rule for it. For example: Add the line below to the /etc/audit/audit.rules file: -w /var/run/docker.sock -k docker  Then restart the audit daemon. For example: systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact_en: Auditing can generate large log files. You should ensure that these are rotated and archived periodically. A separate partition should also be created for audit logs to avoid filling up any other critical partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker related files and directories are not audited. The file docker.socket may not be present, but if it is, it should be audited.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that Linux kernel capabilities are restricted within containers (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保在容器内限制Linux内核功能（自动）

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，Docker启动容器时使用一组受限的Linux内核功能。这意味着任何进程都可以被授予所需的功能，而不是给它根访问权限。使用Linux内核功能，进程通常不需要以根用户的身份运行
extraDetail.rationale:
Docker支持添加和删除功能。您应该删除容器的正确功能所不需要的所有功能。
具体来说，在Docker提供的默认能力集中，如果不显式地需要NET_RAW能力，则应该删除它，因为它可以让访问容器的攻击者有能力创建伪造的网络流量
extraDetail.audit:
你应该执行以下命令:docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: CapAdd={{.HostConfig.CapAdd }} CapDrop={{ .HostConfig.CapDrop }}'
验证添加和删除的Linux内核功能是否与每个容器实例中的容器进程所需的功能一致。具体来说，如果不需要，请确保删除NET_RAW功能
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行下面的命令来添加所需的功能:
docker run --cap-add={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
您应该执行以下命令来删除不需要的功能:
docker run --cap-drop={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
或者，你可以删除所有当前配置的功能，然后只恢复你特别使用的功能:
docker run --cap-drop=all --cap-add={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
注意，一些设置也可以使用——sysctl选项进行配置，从而进一步减少了对容器功能的需求。这包括不带NET_RAW的无特权ICMP echo套接字，并允许在没有NET_BIND_SERVICE的情况下打开小于1024的任何端口。当使用docker service命令时，也可以添加和删除功能:
docker service create --cap-drop=all --cap-add={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
extraDetail.impact: 对容器内进程的限制取决于Linux功能的有效程度
extraDetail.defaultValue:
默认情况下，以下功能应用于容器:
AUDIT_WRITE, CHOWN,DAC_OVERRIDE, FOWNER, FSETID, KILL, MKNOD, NET_BIND_SERVICE, NET_RAW, SETFCAP, SETGID, SETPCAP, SETUID, SYS_CHROOT
extraDetail.description_en: By default, Docker starts containers with a restricted set of Linux kernel capabilities. This means that any process can be granted the required capabilities instead of giving it root access. Using Linux kernel capabilities, processes in general do not need to run as the root user.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker supports the addition and removal of capabilities. You should remove all capabilities not required for the correct function of the container. Specifically, in the default capability set provided by Docker, the NET_RAW capability should be removed if not explicitly required, as it can give an attacker with access to a container the ability to create spoofed network traffic.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: CapAdd={{ .HostConfig.CapAdd }} CapDrop={{ .HostConfig.CapDrop }}' Verify that the added and deleted Linux kernel capabilities are in line with the ones needed by the container process in each container instance. Specifically, ensure that the NET_RAW capability is removed if not required.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the command below to add required capabilities: docker run --cap-add={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command> You should execute the command below to remove unneeded capabilities: docker run --cap-drop={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command> Alternatively, you could remove all the currently configured capabilities and then restore only the ones you specifically use: docker run --cap-drop=all --cap-add={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command> Note that some settings also can be configured using the --sysctl option, reducing the need for container capabilities even further. This includes unprivileged ICMP echo sockets without NET_RAW and allow opening any port less than 1024 without NET_BIND_SERVICE. Adding and removing capabilities are also possible when the docker service command is used: docker service create --cap-drop=all --cap-add={"Capability 1","Capability 2"} <Run arguments> <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
extraDetail.impact_en: Restrictions on processes within a container are based on which Linux capabilities are in force.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the capabilities below are applied to containers: AUDIT_WRITE CHOWN DAC_OVERRIDE FOWNER FSETID KILL MKNOD NET_BIND_SERVICE NET_RAW SETFCAP SETGID SETPCAP SETUID SYS_CHROOT

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that container sprawl is avoided (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保避免容器蔓延 （手动）

extraDetail.description: 您不应该在同一个主机上保留大量的容器
extraDetail.rationale: 容器的灵活性使运行应用程序的多个实例变得容易，因此间接导致Docker镜像可以存在于不同的安全补丁级别。这还意味着您正在消耗本来可以用于运行“有用”容器的主机资源。在特定主机上拥有超过必要数量的容器会使系统容易受到错误处理、错误配置和碎片化的影响。因此，您应该将给定主机上的容器数量保持在与服务生产应用程序相适应的最小数量
extraDetail.audit:
步骤1 -查找主机上的容器总数:
docker info --format '{{ .Containers }}'
步骤2 -执行下面的命令，查找主机上实际运行或处于停止状态的容器的总数
docker info --format '{{ .ContainersStopped }}'
docker info --format '{{ .ContainersRunning }}'
如果主机上停止的容器数量与实际运行的容器数量之间的差异过大，您可能患有“容器扩张”，应该检查未使用的容器，以确定是否可能删除
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该定期检查每个主机上的容器库存，并使用以下命令清理未被积极使用的容器:
docker container prune
extraDetail.impact: 应该保留正在积极使用的容器，删除不再需要的容器
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker不限制主机上容器的数量
extraDetail.description_en: You should not keep a large number of containers on the same host.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The flexibility of containers makes it easy to run multiple instances of applications and therefore indirectly leads to Docker images that can exist at varying security patch levels. It also means that you are consuming host resources that otherwise could have been used for running 'useful' containers. Having more than just an essential number of containers on a particular host makes the system vulnerable to mishandling, misconfiguration and fragmentation. You should therefore keep the number of containers on a given host to the minimum number commensurate with serving production applications.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1 - Find the total number of containers you have on the host: docker info --format '{{ .Containers }}'  Step 2 - Execute the commands below to find the total number of containers that are actually running or in the stopped state on the host. docker info --format '{{ .ContainersStopped }}'  docker info --format '{{ .ContainersRunning }}'  If the difference between the number of containers that are stopped on the host and the number of containers that are actually running is excessive, you may be suffering from "Container sprawl" and should review the unused containers for potential deletion.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should periodically check your container inventory on each host and clean up containers which are not in active use with the command below: docker container prune
extraDetail.impact_en: You should retain containers that are actively in use, and delete ones which are no longer needed.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker does not restrict the number of containers you may have on a host.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure the logging level is set to 'info' (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保日志记录级别设置为“信息”（自动）

extraDetail.description: 设置Docker守护进程日志级别为info
extraDetail.rationale: 设置一个适当的日志级别，配置Docker守护进程来记录您以后想要查看的事件。info及以上的基本日志级别将捕获除调试日志以外的所有日志。除非有必要，否则不要在debug日志级别运行Docker守护进程
extraDetail.audit:
要确认这个设置，需要检查dockerd启动选项和检查/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置，要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
确保——log-level参数不存在，或者如果存在，则将其设置为info
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation:
确保Docker守护进程配置文件包含以下配置
"log-level": "info"
或者，运行Docker守护进程，如下所示:
dockerd --log-level="info"
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker守护进程设置为info的日志级别
extraDetail.description_en: Set Docker daemon log level to info.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Setting up an appropriate log level, configures the Docker daemon to log events that you would want to review later. A base log level of info and above would capture all logs except debug logs. Until and unless required, you should not run Docker daemon at debug log level.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting a combination of reviewing the dockerd start-up options and a review of any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json should be completed. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd Ensure that either the --log-level parameter is not present or if present, then it is set to info. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed for this setting.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Ensure that the Docker daemon configuration file has the following configuration included "log-level": "info" Alternatively, run the Docker daemon as below: dockerd --log-level="info"
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker daemon is set to log level of info.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the docker.service file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将docker.service文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证docker.service文件所有权和组所有权是否正确设置为root
extraDetail.rationale: docker.service文件包含可能改变Docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该由root用户单独或组拥有，以确保它不被特权较低的用户修改或损坏
extraDetail.audit:
步骤1:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，则执行下面的命令，包括正确的文件路径，以验证该文件是root所拥有的和组,例如:
stat -c %U:%G /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service | grep -v root:root
上面的命令不应该返回任何东西
extraDetail.remediation:
步骤1:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件确实存在，您应该执行下面的命令，包括正确的文件路径，以便将文件的所有权和组所有权设置为root,例如:
chown root:root /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service
extraDetail.defaultValue: 该文件可能不存在于系统中，如果不存在，则此建议不适用。默认情况下，如果文件存在，正确的权限是所有权和组所有权设置为“root”

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that a daemon-wide custom seccomp profile is applied if appropriate (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保在适当的情况下应用了守护程序范围的自定义seccomp配置文件（手动）

extraDetail.description: 如果需要，您可以选择在守护进程级应用自定义seccomp配置文件，该配置文件覆盖Docker的默认seccomp配置文件
extraDetail.rationale:
大量的系统调用向每个用户域进程公开，其中许多在进程的整个生命周期内没有被使用。许多应用程序不需要所有这些系统调用，因此，根据组织安全策略审查当前使用的每个系统调用会使其受益。减少的系统调用集减少了向应用程序公开的总内核表面，从而提高了应用程序的安全性
可以应用自定义的seccomp配置文件，而不是Docker默认的seccomp配置文件。或者，如果Docker的默认概要文件对您的环境已经足够，您可以选择忽略这个建议
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行下面的命令并查看Security Options部分中列出的seccomp配置文件。如果为default，则表示应用了Docker的默认seccomp配置文件
docker info --format '{{ .SecurityOptions }}'
extraDetail.remediation:
默认情况下，Docker的默认seccomp配置文件被应用。如果这对您的环境已经足够，则不需要执行任何操作。另外，如果您选择应用自己的seccomp配置文件，请在守护进程启动时使用——seccomp-profile标志，或者将其放在守护进程运行时参数文件中
dockerd --seccomp-profile </path/to/seccomp/profile>
extraDetail.impact: 配置错误的seccomp配置文件可能会中断容器环境。Docker-default阻塞调用已经被仔细检查过，并解决了容器环境中的一些关键漏洞/问题(例如，内核密钥环调用)。因此，如果选择覆盖默认设置，您应该格外小心
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker应用一个默认的seccomp配置文件
extraDetail.description_en: You can choose to apply a custom seccomp profile at a daemon-wide level if needed with this overriding Docker's default seccomp profile.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A large number of system calls are exposed to every userland process with many of them not utilized during the entire lifetime of the process. Many applications do not need all these system calls and therefore benefit by having each system call currently in use reviewed in line with organizational security policy. A reduced set of system calls reduces the total kernel surface exposed to the application and therefore improves application security. A custom seccomp profile can be applied instead of Docker's default seccomp profile. Alternatively, if Docker's default profile is adequate for your environment, you can choose to ignore this recommendation.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below and review the seccomp profile listed in the Security Options section. If it is default this indicates that Docker's default seccomp profile is applied. docker info --format '{{ .SecurityOptions }}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: By default, Docker's default seccomp profile is applied. If this is adequate for your environment, no action is necessary. Alternatively, if you choose to apply your own seccomp profile, use the --seccomp-profile flag at daemon start or put it in the daemon runtime parameters file. dockerd --seccomp-profile </path/to/seccomp/profile>
extraDetail.impact_en: A misconfigured seccomp profile could possibly interrupt your container environment. Docker-default blocked calls have been carefully scrutinized and address some critical vulnerabilities/issues within container environments (for example, kernel key ring calls). You should therefore exercise extreme care if you choose to override the default settings.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker applies a default seccomp profile.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that CA certificates are rotated as appropriate (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保适当地轮换CA证书（手动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该根据实际情况轮换根CA证书
extraDetail.rationale: Docker Swarm使用TLS在节点之间进行集群操作。证书旋转可确保在发生节点或密钥受损等事件时，难以模拟节点。节点证书依赖于根CA证书。为了行动安全，经常轮换是很重要的。目前，根CA证书不会自动轮换，因此您应该建立一个过程来根据您的组织安全策略轮换它们
extraDetail.audit:
您应该检查根CA证书文件上的时间戳，例如:
ls -l /var/lib/docker/swarm/certificates/swarm-root-ca.crt
证书应该显示与组织轮换策略一致的时间戳
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该运行下面的命令来更新证书
docker swarm ca --rotate
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不更新根CA证书
extraDetail.description_en: You should rotate root CA certificates as appropriate.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker Swarm uses TLS for clustering operations between its nodes. Certificate rotation ensures that in an event such as a compromised node or key, it is difficult to impersonate a node. Node certificates depend upon root CA certificates. For operational security, it is important to rotate these frequently. Currently, root CA certificates are not rotated automatically and you should therefore establish a process for rotating them in line with your organizational security policy.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should check the time stamp on the root CA certificate file. For example: ls -l /var/lib/docker/swarm/certificates/swarm-root-ca.crt The certificate should show a time stamp in line with the organizational rotation policy.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the command below to rotate a certificate. docker swarm ca --rotate
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, root CA certificates are not rotated.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure privileged ports are not mapped within containers (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保特权端口未在容器内映射（自动）

extraDetail.description: 小于1024的TCP/IP端口号被认为是特权端口。出于各种安全原因，不允许普通用户和进程使用它们。但是Docker允许将一个容器端口映射到一个特权端口
extraDetail.rationale: 默认情况下，如果用户没有明确声明一个容器端口到主机端口的映射关系，Docker会自动并正确地将该容器端口映射到主机上49153- 65535范围内的可用容器端口。但是，如果用户显式地声明了容器端口，Docker允许将容器端口映射到主机上的特权端口。这是因为容器是使用NET_BIND_SERVICE Linux内核功能执行的，该功能不限制特权端口映射。特权端口接收和传输各种安全敏感的数据，允许容器使用它们不符合良好的安全实践
extraDetail.audit:
您可以通过执行以下命令列出所有正在运行的容器实例及其端口映射:
docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Ports={{.NetworkSettings.Ports }}'
然后应该检查该列表，确保容器端口没有映射到1024以下的主机端口号
extraDetail.remediation: 在启动容器时，不应该将容器端口映射到特权主机端口。您还应该确保Dockerfile中没有这样的容器来承载特权端口映射声明
extraDetail.defaultValue:
默认情况下，允许将容器端口映射到主机的特权端口
注意:在某些情况下，您可能希望映射特权端口，因为如果禁止它，则相应的应用程序必须在容器外部运行
例如:HTTP和HTTPS负载均衡器需要分别绑定80/tcp和443/tcp。禁止映射特权端口有效地禁止在容器中运行这些端口，并强制使用外部负载均衡器。在这种情况下，应该将这些容器实例标记为本建议的例外
extraDetail.description_en: The TCP/IP port numbers below 1024 are considered privileged ports. Normal users and processes are not allowed to use them for various security reasons. Docker does, however allow a container port to be mapped to a privileged port.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By default, if the user does not specifically declare a container port to host port mapping, Docker automatically and correctly maps the container port to one available in the 49153-65535 range on the host. Docker does, however, allow a container port to be mapped to a privileged port on the host if the user explicitly declares it. This is because containers are executed with NET_BIND_SERVICE Linux kernel capability which does not restrict privileged port mapping. The privileged ports receive and transmit various pieces of data which are security sensitive and allowing containers to use them is not in line with good security practice.
extraDetail.audit_en: You can list all running containers instances and their port mappings by executing the command below: docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Ports={{ .NetworkSettings.Ports }}' You should then review the list and ensure that container ports are not mapped to host port numbers below 1024.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not map container ports to privileged host ports when starting a container. You should also, ensure that there is no such container to host privileged port mapping declarations in the Dockerfile. 177 | Page
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, mapping a container port to a privileged port on the host is allowed. Note: There might be certain cases where you want to map privileged ports, because if you forbid it, then the corresponding application has to run outside of a container. For example: HTTP and HTTPS load balancers have to bind 80/tcp and 443/tcp respectively. Forbidding to map privileged ports effectively forbids from running those in a container, and mandates using an external load balancer. In such cases, those containers instances should be marked as exceptions for this recommendation.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the Docker socket is not mounted inside any containers (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保 Docker socket 未安装在任何容器内（自动）

extraDetail.description: Docker套接字docker.sock不应该安装在容器中。在这种情况下，应该将这些容器实例标记为本建议的例外
extraDetail.rationale: 如果Docker套接字安装在一个容器中，它可以允许在容器中运行的进程执行Docker命令，这将有效地允许对主机的完全控制
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:Volumes={{ .Mounts }}' | grep docker.sock
这将返回docker.sock作为卷映射到容器的任何实例
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该确保没有容器将docker.sock挂载为卷
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，docker.sock不会挂载到容器中
extraDetail.description_en: The Docker socket docker.sock should not be mounted inside a container.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the Docker socket is mounted inside a container it could allow processes running within the container to execute Docker commands which would effectively allow for full control of the host.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Volumes={{ .Mounts }}' | grep docker.sock  This would return any instances where docker.sock had been mapped to a container as a volume.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should ensure that no containers mount docker.sock as a volume.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, docker.sock is not mounted inside containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that docker.service file permissions are appropriately set (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保正确设置了docker.service文件权限（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证docker.service文件权限设置为644或更严格的值
extraDetail.rationale: docker.service文件包含可能改变Docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，除了root用户，其他任何用户都不能写它，以确保特权较低的用户不能修改它
extraDetail.audit:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，则执行下面的命令，包括正确的文件路径，以验证文件权限是否设置为644或更严格的值，例如:
stat -c %a /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service
extraDetail.remediation:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，则执行下面的命令，包括正确的文件路径，将文件权限设置为644，例如:
chmod 644 /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service
extraDetail.defaultValue: 此文件可能不存在于系统中。在这种情况下，本建议不适用。默认情况下，如果文件存在，则文件权限被正确设置为644
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the docker.service file permissions are either set to 644 or to a more restrictive value.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The docker.service file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the Docker daemon. It should therefore not be writable by any other user other than root in order to ensure that it can not be modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file exists, execute the command below, including the correct file path in order to verify that the file permissions are set to 644 or a more restrictive value. For example: stat -c %a /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service
extraDetail.remediation_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file exists, execute the command below including the correct file path to set the file permissions to 644. For example, chmod 644 /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system. In that case, this recommendation is not applicable. By default, if the file is present, the file permissions are correctly set to 644.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure sensitive host system directories are not mounted on containers (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保敏感主机系统目录未安装在容器上（自动）

extraDetail.description:
不应该允许将敏感的主机系统目录(如下面列出的目录)作为容器卷挂载，特别是在读写模式下。
/, /boot, /dev, /etc, /lib, /proc, /sys, /usr
extraDetail.rationale: 如果以读写模式挂载敏感目录，则可以对其中的文件进行更改。这有明显的安全影响，应该避免
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:Volumes={{ .Mounts }}'
此命令返回当前映射目录的列表，并指示它们是否以读写模式挂载于每个容器实例
extraDetail.remediation: 不应该在容器内的主机上挂载安全敏感的目录，特别是在读写模式下
extraDetail.defaultValue: Docker默认使用读写卷，但也可以以只读方式挂载目录。默认情况下，容器内不挂载敏感的主机目录
extraDetail.description_en: You should not allow sensitive host system directories such as those listed below to be mounted as container volumes, especially in read-write mode. / /boot /dev /etc /lib /proc /sys /usr
extraDetail.rationale_en: If sensitive directories are mounted in read-write mode, it could be possible to make changes to files within them. This has obvious security implications and should be avoided.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Volumes={{ .Mounts }}' This command returns a list of currently mapped directories and indicates whether they are mounted in read-write mode for each container instance.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not mount directories which are security sensitive on the host within containers, especially in read-write mode.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Docker defaults to using a read-write volume but you can also mount a directory read-only. By default, no sensitive host directories are mounted within containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the container is restricted from acquiring additional privileges (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保限制容器获取其他特权（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该限制容器通过suid或sgid位获得额外的特权
extraDetail.rationale: 进程可以在内核中设置no_new_priv位，这将在fork、clones和execve中持续存在。no_new_priv位确保进程及其子进程不会通过suid或sgid位获得任何额外的特权。这减少了与许多操作相关的危险，因为破坏特权二进制文件的可能性减少了
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:SecurityOpt={{ .HostConfig.SecurityOpt }}'
这个命令应该返回当前为容器配置的所有安全选项。no-new-privilege应该是其中之一
注意，即使Docker daemon.json配置文件中配置了"no-new-privileges": true, SecurityOpt响应也将为空(i.e. SecurityOpt=<no value>)
extraDetail.remediation:
你应该用下面的选项开始你的容器:
docker run --rm -it --security-opt=no-new-privileges ubuntu bash
extraDetail.impact: no_new_priv选项阻止SELinux等lsm允许进程获得新的特权
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不限制新增权限
extraDetail.description_en: You should restrict the container from acquiring additional privileges via suid or sgid bits.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A process can set the no_new_priv bit in the kernel and this persists across forks, clones and execve. The no_new_priv bit ensures that the process and its child processes do not gain any additional privileges via suid or sgid bits. This reduces the danger associated with many operations because the possibility of subverting privileged binaries is lessened.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: SecurityOpt={{ .HostConfig.SecurityOpt }}' This command should return all the security options currently configured for containers. no-new-privileges should be one of them. Note that the SecurityOpt response will be empty (i.e. SecurityOpt=<no value>) even if "no-new-privileges": true has been configured in the Docker daemon.json configuration file.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should start your container with the options below: docker run --rm -it --security-opt=no-new-privileges ubuntu bash
extraDetail.impact_en: The no_new_priv option prevents LSMs like SELinux from allowing processes to acquire new privileges
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, new privileges are not restricted. 215 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Set the 'Lifetime Minutes' and 'Renewal Threshold Minutes' values to '15' or lower and '0' respectively
detail_zh: 将‘寿命分钟’和‘更新阈值分钟’值分别设置为‘15’或更低和‘0’

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that, if applicable, an AppArmor Profile is enabled (Automated)
detail_zh: 如果适用，确保已启用AppArmor配置文件（自动）

extraDetail.description: AppArmor是一个有效的、易于使用的Linux应用程序安全系统。默认情况下，它可以在某些Linux发行版上使用，例如Debian和Ubuntu
extraDetail.rationale: AppArmor通过实施安全策略(也称为AppArmor配置文件)来保护Linux操作系统和应用程序免受各种威胁。您可以为容器创建自己的AppArmor配置文件，也可以使用Docker的默认配置文件。启用此功能将强制在配置文件中定义的容器上执行安全策略
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:AppArmorProfile={{ .AppArmorProfile }}'
该命令应该为每个容器实例返回有效的AppArmor配置文件
extraDetail.remediation:
如果AppArmor适用于您的Linux操作系统，您应该启用它
1. 验证是否安装了AppArmor
2. 为Docker容器创建或导入一个AppArmor配置文件
3.启用策略的实施
4. 使用定制的AppArmor配置文件启动Docker容器。例如:
docker run --interactive --tty --security-opt="apparmor:PROFILENAME" ubuntu /bin/bash
另外，也可以使用Docker默认的AppArmor策略
extraDetail.impact: 容器将具有在AppArmor配置文件中定义的安全控制。应该注意的是，如果AppArmor配置文件配置错误，这可能会导致容器的操作出现问题
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，docker-default AppArmor配置文件应用于正在运行的容器。Docker二进制文件生成这个概要文件，然后将其加载到内核中

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the host's process namespace is not shared (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保不共享主机的进程名称空间（自动）

extraDetail.description: 进程ID (PID)命名空间隔离了进程ID空间，这意味着不同PID命名空间中的进程可以具有相同的PID。这将在容器和主机之间创建进程级隔离
extraDetail.rationale: PID命名空间提供了进程之间的分离。它阻止了系统进程的可见性，并允许进程id被重用，包括PID 1。如果主机的PID命名空间与容器共享，它基本上允许这些容器查看主机系统上的所有进程。这降低了主机和容器之间进程级隔离的好处。在这种情况下，能够访问容器的恶意用户可以访问主机本身上的进程，操纵它们，甚至能够杀死它们。这可能导致主机本身被关闭，这可能是非常严重的，特别是在多租户环境中。不应该与主机上运行的容器共享主机的进程名称空间
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:PidMode={{ .HostConfig.PidMode }}'
如果上面的命令返回host，这意味着主机PID命名空间与其容器共享;任何其他结果都意味着系统的配置符合良好的安全实践
extraDetail.remediation:
你不应该用——pid=host参数开始一个容器。例如，不要用下面的命令启动一个容器:
docker run --interactive --tty --pid=host centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact:
容器进程不能看到主机系统上的进程。在某些情况下，您可能希望容器共享主机的进程名称空间。例如，您可以构建一个包含诸如strace或gdb等调试工具的容器，并希望在调试主机上的进程时使用这些工具。如果需要这样做，那么使用-p开关共享特定的主机进程。
例如:
docker run --pid=host rhel7 strace -p 1234
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，所有容器都启用了PID名称空间，因此主机的进程名称空间不与其容器共享
extraDetail.description_en: The Process ID (PID) namespace isolates the process ID space, meaning that processes in different PID namespaces can have the same PID. This creates process level isolation between the containers and the host.
extraDetail.rationale_en: PID namespace provides separation between processes. It prevents system processes from being visible, and allows process ids to be reused including PID 1. If the host's PID namespace is shared with containers, it would basically allow these to see all of the processes on the host system. This reduces the benefit of process level isolation between the host and the containers. Under these circumstances a malicious user who has access to a container could get access to processes on the host itself, manipulate them, and even be able to kill them. This could allow for the host itself being shut down, which could be extremely serious, particularly in a multi-tenanted environment. You should not share the host's process namespace with the containers running on it.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: PidMode={{ .HostConfig.PidMode }}' If the command above returns host, it means that the host PID namespace is shared with its containers; any other result means that the system is configured in line with good security practice.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not start a container with the --pid=host argument. For example, do not start a container with the command below: docker run --interactive --tty --pid=host centos /bin/bash
extraDetail.impact_en: Container processes cannot see processes on the host system. In certain circumstances, you may want your container to share the host's process namespace. For example, you could build a container containing debugging tools such as strace or gdb, and want to use these tools when debugging processes on the host. If this is desired, then share specific host processes using the -p switch. For example: docker run --pid=host rhel7 strace -p 1234
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, all containers have the PID namespace enabled and the therefore the host's process namespace is not shared with its containers.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that Docker server certificate file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保Docker服务器证书文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证Docker服务器证书文件(随——tlscert参数一起传递的文件)是root所拥有的个人和组
extraDetail.rationale: Docker服务器证书文件应该受到保护，不受任何篡改。它用于基于给定的服务器证书对Docker服务器进行身份验证。因此，它必须由root单独拥有和组拥有，以防止特权较低的用户进行修改
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证Docker服务器证书文件是由root单独拥有和组拥有的:
stat -c %U:%G <path to Docker server certificate file> | grep -v root:root
上面的命令应该不返回任何结果
extraDetail.remediation:
应该执行以下命令:
chown root:root <path to Docker server certificate file>
这将Docker server证书文件的个人所有权和组所有权设置为root
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker server证书文件的归属和组归属都正确设置为root
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the Docker server certificate file (the file that is passed along with the --tlscert parameter) is individual owned and group owned by root.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Docker server certificate file should be protected from any tampering. It is used to authenticate the Docker server based on the given server certificate. It must therefore be individually owned and group owned by root to prevent modification by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the Docker server certificate file is individually owned and group owned by root: stat -c %U:%G <path to Docker server certificate file> | grep -v root:root The above command should return no results.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the following command: chown root:root <path to Docker server certificate file> This sets the individual ownership and the group ownership for the Docker server certificate file to root.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the ownership and group-ownership for Docker server certificate file is correctly set to root. 112 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that incoming container traffic is bound to a specific host interface (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保传入容器流量绑定到特定主机接口（自动）

extraDetail.description: 默认情况下，Docker容器可以与外部世界建立连接，但是外部世界不能连接到容器，而且每个传出的连接似乎都来自主机自己的一个IP地址。您应该只允许通过主机上的特定外部接口联系容器服务
extraDetail.rationale: 如果您的主机上有多个网络接口，容器可以接受任何网络接口上公开端口上的连接。这可能是不可取的，也可能不安全。在许多情况下，一个特定的、想要的接口对外公开，而诸如入侵检测、入侵防御、防火墙、负载平衡等服务都是有意在那里运行的，以筛选传入的公共流量。因此，您不应该接受任何随机接口上的传入连接，而应该只接受指定用于这种类型流量的接口
extraDetail.audit:
你应该通过执行下面的命令列出所有正在运行的容器实例和它们的端口映射:
docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Ports={{.NetworkSettings.Ports }}'
然后检查列表，确保公开的容器端口绑定到特定的接口，而不是通配符IP地址0.0.0.0
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该将容器端口绑定到所需主机端口上的特定主机接口。例如,
docker run --detach --publish 10.2.3.4:49153:80 nginx
在上面的示例中，容器端口80绑定到49153上的主机端口，只接受来自10.2.3.4外部接口的传入连接
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker在0.0.0.0上公开容器端口，这个通配符IP地址将匹配主机上任何可能传入的网络接口
extraDetail.description_en: By default, Docker containers can make connections to the outside world, but the outside world cannot connect to containers and each outgoing connection will appear to originate from one of the host machine's own IP addresses. You should only allow container services to be contacted through a specific external interface on the host machine.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If you have multiple network interfaces on your host machine, the container can accept connections on exposed ports on any network interface. This might not be desirable and may not be secured. In many cases a specific, desired interface is exposed externally and services such as intrusion detection, intrusion prevention, firewall, load balancing, etc. are all run by intention there to screen incoming public traffic. You should therefore not accept incoming connections on any random interface, but only the one designated for this type of traffic.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should list all running instances of containers and their port mappings by executing the command below: docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Ports={{ .NetworkSettings.Ports }}' Then review the list and ensure that the exposed container ports are bound to a specific interface and not to the wildcard IP address 0.0.0.0. For example, if the command above returns the results below, this is non-compliant and the container can accept connections on any host interface on the specified port 49153. Ports=map[443/tcp:<nil> 80/tcp:[map[HostPort:49153 HostIp:0.0.0.0]]] However, if the exposed port is bound to a specific interface on the host as below, then this is configured in line with good security practice. Ports=map[443/tcp:<nil> 80/tcp:[map[HostIp:10.2.3.4 HostPort:49153]]]
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should bind the container port to a specific host interface on the desired host port. For example, docker run --detach --publish 10.2.3.4:49153:80 nginx In the example above, the container port 80 is bound to the host port on 49153 and would accept incoming connection only from the 10.2.3.4 external interface.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker exposes the container ports on 0.0.0.0, the wildcard IP address that will match any possible incoming network interface on the host machine.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that host devices are not directly exposed to containers (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保主机设备没有直接暴露在容器中（手动）

extraDetail.description: 主机设备可以在运行时直接暴露给容器。不要将主机设备直接暴露给容器，特别是不受信任的容器
extraDetail.rationale:
device选项向容器公开主机设备，因此，容器可以直接访问这些设备。容器不需要以特权模式运行来访问和操作它们，因为默认情况下，容器被授予这种类型的访问权限。此外，容器还可以从主机上删除块设备。因此，不应该将主机设备直接暴露给容器
如果出于某种原因，您希望将主机设备暴露给容器，您应该考虑在具体情况的基础上使用哪种共享权限，以适合您的组织:
•r -只读
•w -可写
•允许m - mknod allowed
extraDetail.audit:
你应该使用下面的命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:Devices={{ .HostConfig.Devices }}'
上面的命令将列出每个设备的以下信息:
•CgroupPermissions—例如，rwm
•PathInContainer—容器中的设备路径
•PathOnHost -主机上的设备路径
您应该验证需要从容器内部访问主机设备，并且正确设置了所需的权限。如果上面的命令返回[]，那么容器就不能访问主机设备，并且按照良好的安全实践进行了配置
extraDetail.remediation:
不应该将主机设备直接暴露给容器。如果你确实需要将主机设备暴露给容器，你应该根据你的组织使用适当的粒度权限:
例如，不要使用下面的命令启动一个容器:
docker run --interactive --tty --device=/dev/tty0:/dev/tty0:rwm --device=/dev/temp_sda:/dev/temp_sda:rwm centos bash
您应该只使用适当的权限共享主机设备:
docker run --interactive --tty --device=/dev/tty0:/dev/tty0:rw --
device=/dev/temp_sda:/dev/temp_sda:r centos bash
extraDetail.impact: 您将不能直接在容器中使用主机设备
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，主机设备不暴露给容器。如果不提供共享权限并选择将主机设备公开给容器，则主机设备将被公开为read、write和mknod权限
extraDetail.description_en: Host devices can be directly exposed to containers at runtime. Do not directly expose host devices to containers, especially to containers that are not trusted.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The --device option exposes host devices to containers and as a result of this, containers can directly access these devices. The the container would not need to run in privileged mode to access and manipulate them, as by default, the container is granted this type of access. Additionally, it would possible for containers to remove block devices from the host. You therefore should not expose host devices to containers directly. If for some reason you wish to expose the host device to a container you should consider which sharing permissions you wish to use on a case by case base as appropriate to your organization: • r - read only • w - writable • m - mknod allowed
extraDetail.audit_en: You should use the command below: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Devices={{ .HostConfig.Devices }}' The above command would list out each device with below information: •  CgroupPermissions - For example, rwm •  PathInContainer - Device path within the container •  PathOnHost - Device path on the host You should verify that the host device is needed to be accessed from within the container and that the permissions required are correctly set. If the above command returns [], then the container does not have access to host devices and is configured in line with good security practice.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not directly expose host devices to containers. If you do need to expose host devices to containers, you should use granular permissions as appropriate to your organization: For example, do not start a container using the command below: docker run --interactive --tty --device=/dev/tty0:/dev/tty0:rwm --device=/dev/temp_sda:/dev/temp_sda:rwm centos bash You should only share the host device using appropriate permissions: docker run --interactive --tty --device=/dev/tty0:/dev/tty0:rw --device=/dev/temp_sda:/dev/temp_sda:r centos bash
extraDetail.impact_en: You would not be able to use host devices directly within containers.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, host devices are not exposed to containers. If you do not provide sharing permissions and choose to expose a host device to a container, the host device is be exposed with read, write and mknod permissions.

detail_en: Ensure that the swarm manager auto-lock key is rotated periodically (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保群管理器自动锁定键定期旋转（手动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该定期旋转Swarm管理器自动锁定keys
extraDetail.rationale: swarm管理器自动锁定key不会自动旋转。良好的安全实践是旋转密钥
extraDetail.audit: 目前，还没有一种机制可以找出最后一次在swarm管理节点上旋转密钥是什么时候。您应该与系统管理员联系，查看是否存在key旋转过程，以及键旋转的频率
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该运行下面的命令来旋转keys

此外，为了便于对该建议进行审核，您应该保持key旋转记录，并确保您为key旋转建立了预定义的频率

extraDetail.description_en: You should rotate the swarm manager auto-lock key periodically.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The swarm manager auto-lock key is not automatically rotated. Good security practice is to rotate keys.
extraDetail.audit_en: Currently, there is no mechanism to find out when the key was last rotated on a swarm manager node. You should check with the system administrator to see if there is a key rotation process, and how often the key is rotated.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the command below to rotate the keys. docker swarm unlock-key --rotate Additionally, to facilitate auditing of this recommendation, you should maintain key rotation records and ensure that you establish a pre-defined frequency for key rotation.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, keys are not rotated automatically.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure auditing is configured for Docker files and directories - docker.service (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保为Docker文件和目录配置了审计-docker.service（自动）

extraDetail.description: 适用情况下,审计docker.service
extraDetail.rationale: 除了审计普通的Linux文件系统和系统调用之外，还应该审计所有与Docker相关的文件和目录。Docker守护进程使用root特权运行，它的行为依赖于一些关键文件和目录，docker.service就是其中一个这样的文件。如果管理员更改了守护进程参数，则可能出现docker.service文件。如果是，它包含Docker守护进程的各种参数，应该对其进行审计
extraDetail.audit:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，请确认是否存在与该文件对应的审计规则:
例如，您可以执行以下命令:
auditctl -l | grep docker.service
这应该显示docker.service的一条规则
extraDetail.remediation:
如果该文件存在，则应该为其添加一条规则，例如:
将以下行添加到/etc/audit/audit.rules文件中:
-w /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service -k docker
然后，使用以下命令重新启动审计守护进程
systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact: 审计可以生成较大的日志文件。您应该确保定期轮换和归档这些文件。还应该为审计日志创建一个单独的分区，以避免填充任何其他关键分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不审计Docker相关的文件和目录。系统上可能没有docker.service文件
extraDetail.description_en: Audit the docker.service if applicable.
extraDetail.rationale_en: As well as auditing the normal Linux file system and system calls, you should also audit all Docker related files and directories. The Docker daemon runs with root privileges and its behavior depends on some key files and directories with docker.service being one such file. The docker.service file might be present if the daemon parameters have been changed by an administrator. If so, it holds various parameters for the Docker daemon and should be audited.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.service Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation does not apply. If the file does exist, verify that there is an audit rule corresponding to the file: For example, you could execute the command below: auditctl -l | grep docker.service  This should display a rule for docker.service.
extraDetail.remediation_en: If the file exists, a rule for it should be added. For example: Add the line as below in /etc/audit/audit.rules file: -w /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.service -k docker  Then restart the audit daemon. For example: systemctl restart auditd
extraDetail.impact_en: Auditing can generate large log files. You should ensure that these are rotated and archived periodically. A separate partition should also be created for audit logs to avoid filling up any other critical partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker related files and directories are not audited. The file docker.service may not be present on the system.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure base device size is not changed until needed (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保基本设备的大小直到需要时才更改（自动）

extraDetail.description: 在某些情况下，您可能需要大于10G的容器。在这种情况下，你应该仔细选择基本设备的大小
extraDetail.rationale:
基本设备大小可以在守护进程重新启动时增加。增加基本设备大小允许所有未来的镜像和容器具有新的基本设备大小。用户可以使用此选项扩展基本设备大小，但不允许缩小。该值影响系统范围的“基本”空文件系统，该文件系统可能已经初始化，因此被提取的镜像继承。
尽管只要文件系统为空，它就不会分配增加的大小，但是会为额外的镜像分配更多的空间。如果分配的分区已满，这可能会导致拒绝服务条件
extraDetail.audit:
为了确认这个设置，应该检查dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置
要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
执行上面的命令，它应该不会显示任何——storage-opt dm.basesize参数
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation: 除非需要，否则不要设置——storage-opt dm.basesize
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认的基本设备大小是10G
extraDetail.description_en: Under certain circumstances, you might need containers larger than 10G. Where this applies you should carefully choose the base device size.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The base device size can be increased on daemon restart. Increasing the base device size allows all future images and containers to be of the new base device size. A user can use this option to expand the base device size, however shrinking is not permitted. This value affects the system wide “base” empty filesystem that may already be initialized and therefore inherited by pulled images. Although the file system does not allocate the increased size as long as it is empty, more space will be allocated for extra images. This may cause a denial of service condition if the allocated partition becomes full.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting the dockerd start-up options and any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json should be reviewed. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd Execute the above command and it should not show any --storage-opt dm.basesize parameters. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed
extraDetail.remediation_en: Do not set --storage-opt dm.basesize until needed.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: The default base device size is 10G.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure Userland Proxy is Disabled (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保Userland代理已禁用（自动）

extraDetail.description: Docker守护进程在端口暴露时启动用户域代理服务进行端口转发。在发夹NAT可用的情况下，该服务通常是多余的，可以禁用
extraDetail.rationale:
Docker引擎提供了两种将端口从主机转发到容器的机制:发夹NAT和使用用户域代理。在大多数情况下，发夹NAT模式是首选的，因为它可以提高性能并利用本机Linux iptables功能，而不是使用额外的组件
在发夹NAT可用的地方，用户域代理应该在启动时禁用，以减少安装的攻击面
extraDetail.audit:
要确认这个设置，你应该检查dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置。
要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
确保——userland-proxy参数设置为false。
还应该检查/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容
extraDetail.remediation:
你应该像下面这样运行Docker守护进程:
dockerd --userland-proxy=false
extraDetail.impact: 一些使用较老的Linux内核的系统可能无法支持发夹式NAT，因此需要用户域代理服务。此外，删除用户域代理可能会影响一些网络设置
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，用户域代理是启用的
extraDetail.description_en: The Docker daemon starts a userland proxy service for port forwarding whenever a port is exposed. Where hairpin NAT is available, this service is generally superfluous to requirements and can be disabled.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Docker engine provides two mechanisms for forwarding ports from the host to containers, hairpin NAT, and the use of a userland proxy. In most circumstances, the hairpin NAT mode is preferred as it improves performance and makes use of native Linux iptables functionality instead of using an additional component. Where hairpin NAT is available, the userland proxy should be disabled on startup to reduce the attack surface of the installation.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting, you should review the dockerd start-up options and any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd  Ensure that the --userland-proxy parameter is set to false. The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json should also be reviewed for this setting.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the Docker daemon as below: dockerd --userland-proxy=false 86 | Page
extraDetail.impact_en: Some systems with older Linux kernels may not be able to support hairpin NAT and therefore require the userland proxy service. Also, some networking setups can be impacted by the removal of the userland proxy.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the userland proxy is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that TLS CA certificate file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保TLS CA证书文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证TLS CA证书文件(随——tlscacert参数一起传递的文件)是由root单独拥有和组拥有的
extraDetail.rationale: 应该保护TLS CA证书文件不受任何篡改。它用于基于给定的CA证书对Docker服务器进行身份验证。因此，它必须由root单独拥有和组拥有，以确保特权较低的用户不能修改它
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证TLS CA证书文件是root所拥有和组所拥有的:
stat -c %U:%G <path to TLS CA certificate file> | grep -v root:root
上面的命令应该不返回任何结果
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chown root:root <path to TLS CA certificate file>
这将TLS CA证书文件的个人所有权和组所有权设置为root
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，正确设置TLS CA证书文件的归属和组归属为root
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the TLS CA certificate file (the file that is passed along with the --tlscacert parameter) is individually owned and group owned by root.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The TLS CA certificate file should be protected from any tampering. It is used to authenticate the Docker server based on a given CA certificate. It must be therefore be individually owned and group owned by root to ensure that it cannot be modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the TLS CA certificate file is owned and group owned by root: stat -c %U:%G <path to TLS CA certificate file> | grep -v root:root The above command should return no results.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chown root:root <path to TLS CA certificate file> This sets the individual ownership and group ownership for the TLS CA certificate file to root.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the ownership and group-ownership for TLS CA certificate file is correctly set to root. 108 | Page

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that a user for the container has been created (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保已创建容器的用户（自动）

extraDetail.description: 容器应该以非root用户的身份运行
extraDetail.rationale: 在可能的情况下，作为非root用户运行容器是一种很好的实践。这可以通过Dockerfile中的USER指令来完成，也可以通过gosu或类似的方式来作为CMD或ENTRYPOINT指令的一部分
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet | xargs --max-args=1 -I{} docker exec {} cat /proc/1/status | grep '^Uid:' | awk '{print $3}'
这应该为每个容器返回有效的UID，如果返回0，则表示容器进程以root身份运行。
注意，有些服务可能以root用户启动，然后以非特权用户启动所有其他相关进程
extraDetail.remediation:
你应该确保每个容器镜像的Dockerfile包含以下信息:
USER <username or ID>
在本例中，用户名或ID指的是在容器基镜像中找到的用户。如果在容器基镜像中没有创建特定的用户，则使用useradd命令在Dockerfile中的user指令之前添加特定的用户。例如，在Dockerfile中添加以下代码行，在容器中创建一个用户:
RUN useradd -d /home/username -m -s /bin/bash username USER username
注意:如果镜像中有不需要的用户，您应该考虑删除他们。删除这些用户之后，提交镜像，然后生成容器的新实例。
或者，如果无法在Dockerfile中设置USER指令，则应该使用作为CMD或ENTRYPOINT部分的一部分运行的脚本来确保容器进程切换到非根用户
extraDetail.impact: 当您希望从底层主机绑定挂载卷时，作为非root用户运行可能会带来挑战。在这种情况下，应该注意确保运行所包含进程的用户能够根据自己的需求对绑定目录进行读写
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器以root权限运行，也以容器内的root用户运行
extraDetail.description_en: Containers should run as a non-root user.
extraDetail.rationale_en: It is good practice to run the container as a non-root user, where possible. This can be done either via the USER directive in the Dockerfile or through gosu or similar where used as part of the CMD or ENTRYPOINT directives.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command docker ps --quiet | xargs --max-args=1 -I{} docker exec {} cat /proc/1/status | grep '^Uid:' | awk '{print $3}' This should return the effective UID for each container and where it returns 0, it indicates that the container process is running as root. Note that some services may start as the root user and then starts all other related processes as a unprivileged user.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should ensure that the Dockerfile for each container image contains the information below: USER <username or ID> In this case, the user name or ID refers to the user that was found in the container base image. If there is no specific user created in the container base image, then make use of the useradd command to add a specific user before the USER instruction in the Dockerfile. For example, add the below lines in the Dockerfile to create a user in the container: RUN useradd -d /home/username -m -s /bin/bash username USER username  Note: If there are users in the image that are not needed, you should consider deleting them. After deleting those users, commit the image and then generate new instances of the containers. Alternatively, if it is not possible to set the USER directive in the Dockerfile, a script running as part of the CMD or ENTRYPOINT sections of the Dockerfile should be used to ensure that the container process switches to a non-root user.
extraDetail.impact_en: Running as a non-root user can present challenges where you wish to bind mount volumes from the underlying host. In this case, care should be taken to ensure that the user running the contained process can read and write to the bound directory, according to their requirements.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, containers are run with root privileges and also run as the root user inside the container.
