creator: default
detail_en: Ensure TLS authentication for Docker daemon is configured (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保已配置Docker守护程序的TLS身份验证（自动）

extraDetail.description: 可以通过TCP端口使Docker守护进程远程可用。如果需要这样做，应该确保配置了TLS身份验证，以便通过IP地址和端口限制对Docker守护进程的访问
extraDetail.rationale:
默认情况下，Docker守护进程绑定到一个非联网的Unix套接字，并以根权限运行。如果您将默认的Docker守护进程绑定到TCP端口或任何其他Unix套接字，那么任何访问该端口或套接字的人都可以完全访问Docker守护进程，进而访问主机系统。因此，您不应该将Docker守护进程绑定到另一个IP/端口或Unix套接字。
如果您必须通过网络套接字公开Docker守护进程，那么您应该为守护进程和任何Docker Swarm api(如果它们正在使用)配置TLS身份验证。这种类型的配置将通过网络连接到Docker守护进程的连接限制为能够访问TLS客户端凭证的有限数量的客户端
extraDetail.audit:
要确认这个设置，检查dockerd启动选项和/etc/docker/daemon.json中的任何设置。
要查看dockerd启动选项，请使用:
ps -ef | grep dockerd
确保下面的参数是存在的:
--tlsverify, --tlscacert, --tlscert, --tlskey
/etc/docker/daemon.json的内容，以确保这些设置已到位
extraDetail.remediation: 遵循Docker文档或其他参考资料中提到的步骤
extraDetail.impact: 您需要管理和保护Docker守护进程和Docker客户机的证书和密钥
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，未配置TLS认证
extraDetail.description_en: It is possible to make the Docker daemon available remotely over a TCP port. If this is required, you should ensure that TLS authentication is configured in order to restrict access to the Docker daemon via IP address and port.
extraDetail.rationale_en: By default, the Docker daemon binds to a non-networked Unix socket and runs with root privileges. If you change the default Docker daemon binding to a TCP port or any other Unix socket, anyone with access to that port or socket could have full access to the Docker daemon and therefore in turn to the host system. For this reason, you should not bind the Docker daemon to another IP/port or a Unix socket. If you must expose the Docker daemon via a network socket, you should configure TLS authentication for the daemon and for any Docker Swarm APIs (if they are in use). This type of configuration restricts the connections to your Docker daemon over the network to a limited number of clients who have access to the TLS client credentials.
extraDetail.audit_en: To confirm this setting, review the dockerd start-up options and any settings in /etc/docker/daemon.json. To review the dockerd startup options, use: ps -ef | grep dockerd Ensure that the below parameters are present: --tlsverify --tlscacert --tlscert --tlskey The contents of /etc/docker/daemon.json to ensure these settings are in place.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Follow the steps mentioned in the Docker documentation or other references.
extraDetail.impact_en: You would need to manage and guard certificates and keys for the Docker daemon and Docker clients.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, TLS authentication is not configured.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the daemon.json file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将daemon.json文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证daemon.json文件的个人所有权和组所有权是否被正确设置为root(如果它正在使用)
extraDetail.rationale: daemon.json文件包含可能改变docker守护进程行为的敏感参数。因此，它应该由root拥有和组拥有，以确保特权较低的用户不能修改它
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证该文件和组是否为root所拥有:
stat -c %U:%G /etc/docker/daemon.json | grep -v root:root
上面的命令不应该返回任何结果，或者，如果没有daemon.json文件，它将返回:
stat: cannot stat '/etc/docker/daemon.json': No such file or directory
extraDetail.remediation:
如果存在daemon.json文件，您应该执行以下命令:
chown root:root /etc/docker/daemon.json
这将文件的所有权和组所有权设置为root
extraDetail.defaultValue: 该文件可能不存在于系统中，在这种情况下，此建议不适用
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the daemon.json file individual ownership and group ownership is correctly set to root, if it is in use.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The daemon.json file contains sensitive parameters that could alter the behavior of the docker daemon. It should therefore be owned and group owned by root to ensure it can not be modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the file is owned and group owned by root: stat -c %U:%G /etc/docker/daemon.json | grep -v root:root  The command above should not return any results or, if there is no daemon.json file present it will return: stat: cannot stat '/etc/docker/daemon.json': No such file or directory
extraDetail.remediation_en: If the daemon.json file is present, you should execute the command below: chown root:root /etc/docker/daemon.json This sets the ownership and group ownership for the file to root.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system, and in that case, this recommendation is not applicable.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that Docker's secret management commands are used for managing secrets in a swarm cluster (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保使用Docker的密钥管理命令来管理群集集群中的密钥（手动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该使用Docker内置的秘密管理命令来控制秘密
extraDetail.rationale: Docker有各种各样的命令来管理集群中的秘密
extraDetail.audit:
在群集管理节点上，您应该运行下面的命令，并确保在您的环境中使用docker secret管理，这与您的IT安全策略是一致的
docker secret ls
extraDetail.remediation: 您应该遵循docker secret文档并使用它来有效地管理秘密
extraDetail.description_en: You should use Docker's in-built secret management command for control of secrets.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker has various commands for managing secrets in a swarm cluster.
extraDetail.audit_en: On a swarm manager node, you should run the command below and ensure docker secret management is used in your environment where this is in line with your IT security policy. docker secret ls
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should follow the docker secret documentation and use it to manage secrets effectively.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: Not Applicable

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that docker.socket file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保将docker.socket文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证docker.socket文件所有权和组所有权是否正确设置为root
extraDetail.rationale: docker.socket文件包含可能改变Docker远程API行为的敏感参数。由于这个原因，它应该由root拥有和组拥有，以确保它不会被特权较低的用户修改
extraDetail.audit:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，则执行下面的命令，包括正确的文件路径，以验证该文件是root所拥有和组拥有的,例如,
stat -c %U:%G /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket | grep -v root:root
上面的命令不应该返回值
extraDetail.remediation:
第一步:找出文件的位置:
systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket
步骤2:如果文件不存在，则此建议不适用。如果文件存在，则执行以下命令，包括正确的文件路径，将文件的所有权和组所有权设置为root。例如,
chown root:root /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket
extraDetail.defaultValue: 此文件可能不存在于系统中。在这种情况下，本建议不适用。默认情况下，如果文件存在，那么它的所有权和组所有权应该设置为root
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the docker.socket file ownership and group ownership are correctly set to root.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The docker.socket file contains sensitive parameters that may alter the behavior of the Docker remote API. For this reason, it should be owned and group owned by root in order to ensure that it is not modified by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file exists, execute the command below, including the correct file path to verify that the file is owned and group-owned by root. For example, stat -c %U:%G /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket | grep -v root:root  The command above should not return a value.
extraDetail.remediation_en: Step 1: Find out the file location: systemctl show -p FragmentPath docker.socket Step 2: If the file does not exist, this recommendation is not applicable. If the file exists, execute the command below, including the correct file path to set the ownership and group ownership for the file to root. For example, chown root:root /usr/lib/systemd/system/docker.socket
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: This file may not be present on the system. In that case, this recommendation is not applicable. By default, if the file is present, the ownership and group ownership for it should be set to root.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the container's root filesystem is mounted as read only (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保容器的根文件系统已挂载为只读（自动）

extraDetail.description: 通过使用Docker run的——read-only选项，容器的根文件系统应该被视为“黄金镜像”。这防止了在容器运行时对容器根文件系统的任何写入，并强制执行不可变基础结构的原则
extraDetail.rationale:
启用此选项将迫使容器在运行时显式地定义其数据写入策略以持久化或不持久化其数据。
这也减少了安全攻击向量，因为容器实例的文件系统不能被篡改或写入，除非它对其文件系统文件夹和目录具有显式的读写权限
extraDetail.audit:
您应该在docker主机上执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:ReadonlyRootfs={{ .HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs }}'
如果上面的命令返回true，它意味着容器的根文件系统被挂载为read-only。
如果上面的命令返回false，就意味着容器的根文件系统是可写的
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该在容器的运行时添加——read-only标志，以强制将容器的根文件系统挂载为只读
docker run <Run arguments> --read-only <Container Image Name or ID> <Command>
在容器的运行时启用——read-only选项应该被管理员用来强制容器的可执行进程在其生命周期内只将容器数据写入显式的存储位置。
容器运行时显式存储位置的例子包括但不限于:
1. 使用——tmpfs选项为非持久数据写入挂载临时文件系统
docker run --interactive --tty --read-only --tmpfs "/run" --tmpfs "/tmp" centos /bin/bash
2. 启用Docker rw挂载在容器的运行时，直接将容器数据持久化到Docker主机文件系统上
docker run --interactive --tty --read-only -v /opt/app/data:/run/app/data:rw centos /bin/bash
3.利用Docker共享存储卷插件为Docker数据卷持久化容器数据
docker volume create -d convoy --opt o=size=20GB my-named-volume
docker run --interactive --tty --read-only -v my-named-volume:/run/app/data centos /bin/bash
4.在容器运行时为容器数据在Docker控制区域外传输容器数据，以确保它是持久的。示例包括托管数据库、网络文件共享和api
extraDetail.impact:
如果没有定义数据写入策略，在容器运行时启用——只读可能会破坏某些容器操作系统包。
您应该定义容器的数据应该在运行时持久化什么，不应该持久化什么，以便决定使用哪种策略。
例子:
•启用——tmpfs来临时写入/tmp文件
•使用Docker共享数据卷进行持久数据写入
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，容器的根文件系统是可写的，允许所有容器进程写入容器实际运行时用户拥有的文件
extraDetail.description_en: The container's root filesystem should be treated as a 'golden image' by using Docker run's --read-only option. This prevents any writes to the container's root filesystem at container runtime and enforces the principle of immutable infrastructure.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Enabling this option forces containers at runtime to explicitly define their data writing strategy to persist or not persist their data. This also reduces security attack vectors since the container instance's filesystem cannot be tampered with or written to unless it has explicit read-write permissions on its filesystem folder and directories.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command on the docker host: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: ReadonlyRootfs={{ .HostConfig.ReadonlyRootfs }}'  If the above command returns true, it means the container's root filesystem is mounted read-only. If the above command returns false, it means the container's root filesystem is writeable.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should add a --read-only flag at a container's runtime to enforce the container's root filesystem being mounted as read only. docker run <Run arguments> --read-only <Container Image Name or ID> <Command> Enabling the --read-only option at a container's runtime should be used by administrators to force a container's executable processes to only write container data to explicit storage locations during its lifetime. Examples of explicit storage locations during a container's runtime include, but are not limited to: 1. Using the --tmpfs option to mount a temporary file system for non-persistent data writes. docker run --interactive --tty --read-only --tmpfs "/run" --tmpfs "/tmp" centos /bin/bash  2. Enabling Docker rw mounts at a container's runtime to persist container data directly on the Docker host filesystem. docker run --interactive --tty --read-only -v /opt/app/data:/run/app/data:rw centos /bin/bash  3. Utilizing the Docker shared-storage volume plugin for Docker data volume to persist container data. docker volume create -d convoy --opt o=size=20GB my-named-volume docker run --interactive --tty --read-only -v my-named-volume:/run/app/data centos /bin/bash  3. Transmitting container data outside of the Docker controlled area during the container's runtime for container data in order to ensure that it is persistent. Examples include hosted databases, network file shares and APIs.
extraDetail.impact_en: Enabling --read-only at container runtime may break some container OS packages if a data writing strategy is not defined. You should define what the container's data should and should not persist at runtime in order to decide which strategy to use. Example: • Enable use --tmpfs for temporary file writes to /tmp  • Use Docker shared data volumes for persistent data writes
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, a container has its root filesystem writeable, allowing all container processes to write files owned by the container's actual runtime user.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the host's user namespaces are not shared (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保不共享主机的用户名称空间（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您不应该与在主机上运行的容器共享主机的用户名称空间
extraDetail.rationale: 用户名称空间确保容器内的根进程将映射到容器外的非根进程。因此，与容器共享主机的用户名称空间并不会将主机上的用户与容器中的用户隔离开来
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行下面的命令，并确保它不为UsernsMode返回任何值。如果它返回host的值，则意味着主机用户名称空间与其容器共享
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:UsernsMode={{ .HostConfig.UsernsMode }}'
extraDetail.remediation:
不应该在主机和容器之间共享用户名称空间。例如，你不应该运行下面的命令:
docker run --rm -it --userns=host ubuntu bash
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，主机用户名称空间与容器共享，除非启用了用户名称空间支持
extraDetail.description_en: You should not share the host's user namespaces with containers running on it.
extraDetail.rationale_en: User namespaces ensure that a root process inside the container will be mapped to a non-root process outside the container. Sharing the user namespaces of the host with the container does not therefore isolate users on the host from users in the containers.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below and ensure that it does not return any value for UsernsMode. If it returns a value of host, it means that the host user namespace is shared with its containers. docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: UsernsMode={{ .HostConfig.UsernsMode }}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should not share user namespaces between host and containers. For example, you should not run the command below: docker run --rm -it --userns=host ubuntu bash
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the host user namespace is shared with containers unless user namespace support is enabled.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure a separate partition for containers has been created (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保已为容器创建单独的分区（自动）

extraDetail.description: 所有Docker容器及其数据和元数据都存储在/var/lib/docker目录下。默认情况下，/var/lib/docker应该挂载在/或/var分区下，这取决于所使用的Linux操作系统的配置方式
extraDetail.rationale: Docker依赖/var/lib/docker作为所有Docker相关文件(包括镜像)的默认存储目录。这个目录会很快被填满，导致Docker和主机都无法使用。因此，您应该创建一个单独的分区(逻辑卷)来存储Docker文件
extraDetail.audit:
在Docker主机上执行以下命令之一:
grep '/var/lib/docker\s' /proc/mounts
这将返回/var/lib/docker挂载点的分区详细信息
mountpoint -- "$(docker info -f '{{ .DockerRootDir }}')"
这将返回配置的根目录是否为挂载点
extraDetail.remediation: 对于新的安装，您应该为/var/lib/docker挂载点创建一个单独的分区。对于已经安装的系统，您应该使用Linux中的逻辑卷管理器(LVM)来创建一个新分区
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，/var/lib/docker挂载在/或/var分区下，具体取决于操作系统的配置
extraDetail.description_en: All Docker containers and their data and metadata is stored under /var/lib/docker directory. By default, /var/lib/docker should be mounted under either the / or /var partitions dependent on how the Linux operating system in use is configured.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Docker depends on /var/lib/docker as the default directory where all Docker related files, including the images, are stored. This directory could fill up quickly causing both Docker and the host to become unusable. For this reason, you should create a separate partition (logical volume) for storing Docker files.
extraDetail.audit_en: At the Docker host execute one of the below commands: grep '/var/lib/docker\s' /proc/mounts This should return the partition details for the /var/lib/docker mountpoint. mountpoint -- "$(docker info -f '{{ .DockerRootDir }}')" This should return whether the configured root directory is a mount point.
extraDetail.remediation_en: For new installations, you should create a separate partition for the /var/lib/docker mount point. For systems which have already been installed, you should use the Logical Volume Manager (LVM) within Linux to create a new partition.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, /var/lib/docker is mounted under the / or /var partitions dependent on how the OS is configured.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensurethe default seccomp profile is not Disabled (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保默认的seccomp配置文件未禁用（自动）

extraDetail.description: Seccomp筛选为进程指定传入系统调用的筛选器提供了一种方法。默认的Docker seccomp配置文件工作在白名单的基础上，允许大量的公共系统调用，同时阻止所有其他的。不应禁用此筛选，除非它导致容器应用程序的使用出现问题
extraDetail.rationale: 大量的系统调用向每个用户域进程公开，其中许多调用在进程的整个生命周期内都没有使用过。大多数应用程序不需要所有这些系统调用，因此可以从减少可用的系统调用集合中获益。减少系统调用集可以减少向应用程序公开的总内核表面，从而提高应用程序安全性
extraDetail.audit:
应该执行以下命令:
docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}:SecurityOpt={{ .HostConfig.SecurityOpt }}'
这应该返回<no value>或修改后的seccomp配置文件。如果它返回[seccomp:unrestricted]，则表示容器在没有任何seccomp配置文件的情况下运行，因此没有按照良好的安全实践进行配置
extraDetail.remediation: 默认情况下，启用seccomp配置文件。您不需要做任何事情，除非您想修改和使用已修改的seccomp配置文件
extraDetail.impact: 在Docker 1.10及更高版本中，默认的seccomp配置文件会阻塞系统调用，而不管是否向容器传递——cap-add。在这种情况下，您应该创建自己的自定义seccomp配置文件。你也可以通过在docker run上传递--security- opt=seccomp:unconfined来禁用默认的seccomp配置文件
extraDetail.defaultValue: 当运行容器时，它使用默认配置文件，除非使用——security-opt选项覆盖它
extraDetail.description_en: Seccomp filtering provides a means for a process to specify a filter for incoming system calls. The default Docker seccomp profile works on a whitelist basis and allows for a large number of common system calls, whilst blocking all others. This filtering should not be disabled unless it causes a problem with your container application usage.
extraDetail.rationale_en: A large number of system calls are exposed to every userland process with many of them going unused for the entire lifetime of the process. Most of applications do not need all these system calls and would therefore benefit from having a reduced set of available system calls. Having a reduced set of system calls reduces the total kernel surface exposed to the application and thus improvises application security.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the following command: docker ps --quiet --all | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: SecurityOpt={{ .HostConfig.SecurityOpt }}'    This should return either <no value> or your modified seccomp profile. If it returns [seccomp:unconfined], the container is running without any seccomp profiles and is therefore not configured in line with good security practice.
extraDetail.remediation_en: By default, seccomp profiles are enabled. You do not need to do anything unless you want to modify and use a modified seccomp profile. 207 | Page
extraDetail.impact_en: With Docker 1.10 and greater, the default seccomp profile blocks syscalls, regardless of --cap-add passed to the container. You should create your own custom seccomp profile in such cases. You may also disable the default seccomp profile by passing --security-opt=seccomp:unconfined on docker run.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: When you run a container, it uses the default profile unless you override it with the --security-opt option.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that the Docker server certificate key file ownership is set to root:root (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保Docker服务器证书密钥文件所有权设置为root：root（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该验证Docker服务器证书密钥文件(随——tlskey参数一起传递的文件)是root单独拥有的和组拥有的
extraDetail.rationale: Docker服务器证书密钥文件应该受到保护，不受任何篡改或不必要的读/写。由于它持有Docker服务器证书的私钥，因此它必须由root单独拥有和组拥有，以确保特权较低的用户无法访问它
extraDetail.audit:
您应该执行以下命令来验证Docker服务器证书密钥文件是由root单独拥有和组拥有的:
stat -c %U:%G <path to Docker server certificate key file> | grep -v root:root
上面的命令应该不返回任何结果
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该执行以下命令:
chown root:root <path to Docker server certificate key file>
这将Docker服务器证书密钥文件的个人所有权和组所有权设置为root
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker服务器证书密钥文件的个人所有权和组所有权被正确设置为root
extraDetail.description_en: You should verify that the Docker server certificate key file (the file that is passed along with the --tlskey parameter) is individually owned and group owned by root.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Docker server certificate key file should be protected from any tampering or unneeded reads/writes. As it holds the private key for the Docker server certificate, it must be individually owned and group owned by root to ensure that it cannot be accessed by less privileged users.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should execute the command below to verify that the Docker server certificate key file is individually owned and group owned by root: stat -c %U:%G <path to Docker server certificate key file> | grep -v root:root The command above should return no results.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should execute the following command: chown root:root <path to Docker server certificate key file> This sets the individual ownership and group ownership for the Docker server certificate key file to root.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, the individual ownership and group ownership for the Docker server certificate key file is correctly set to root.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure update instructions are not use alone in the Dockerfile (Manual)
detail_zh: 确保更新说明不单独在Dockerfile中使用（手动）

extraDetail.description: 你不应该单独使用操作系统包管理器更新指令，如apt-get update或yum update，也不应该在任何dockerfile中单独使用这类指令，这些dockerfile用于生成被审查的镜像
extraDetail.rationale: 在Dockerfile的单行中添加更新指令将导致更新层被缓存。当您随后使用相同的指令构建任何镜像时，这将导致使用先前缓存的更新层，从而潜在地阻止任何新的更新应用到以后的构建
extraDetail.audit:
步骤1:运行下面的命令获取镜像列表:
docker images
第二步:对上面列表中的每一个镜像运行下面的命令，寻找包含在一行中的任何更新指令:
docker history <Image_ID>
或者，如果您可以访问镜像的Dockerfile，则应该验证没有如上所述配置的更新说明
extraDetail.remediation:
在安装包时，应该将更新指示与安装指示和版本固定一起使用。这将防止缓存并强制提取所需的版本
或者，你可以在docker build过程中使用——no-cache标志来避免使用缓存层
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，Docker对使用更新指令没有任何限制
extraDetail.description_en: You should not use OS package manager update instructions such as apt-get update or yum update either alone or in a single line in any Dockerfiles used to generate images under review.
extraDetail.rationale_en: Adding update instructions in a single line on the Dockerfile will cause the update layer to be cached. When you then build any image later using the same instruction, this will cause the previously cached update layer to be used, potentially preventing any fresh updates from being applied to later builds.
extraDetail.audit_en: Step 1: Run the command below to get the list of images: docker images  Step 2: Run the command below against each image in the list above, looking for any update instructions which are incorporated in a single line: docker history <Image_ID> Alternatively, if you have access to the Dockerfile for the image, you should verify that there are no update instructions configured as described above.
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should use update instructions together with install instructions and version pinning for packages while installing them. This will prevent caching and force the extraction of the required versions. Alternatively, you could use the --no-cache flag during the docker build process to avoid using cached layers.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, Docker does not enforce any restrictions on using update instructions.

creator: default
detail_en: Ensure that container health is checked at runtime (Automated)
detail_zh: 确保在运行时检查容器的运行状况（自动）

extraDetail.description: 如果容器镜像没有定义HEALTHCHECK指令，则应该在容器运行时使用——health-cmd参数来检查容器运行状况
extraDetail.rationale:
如果正在使用的容器镜像没有预定义的HEALTHCHECK指令，请在运行时使用——health-cmd参数检查容器运行状况。
根据所报告的健康状况，必要时可采取补救行动
extraDetail.audit:
您应该运行以下命令，并确保所有容器都在报告它们的运行状况状态:
docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Health={{.State.Health.Status }}
extraDetail.remediation:
您应该使用——health-cmd参数运行容器。例如:
docker run -d --health-cmd='stat /etc/passwd || exit 1' nginx
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不在容器运行时执行运行状况检查
extraDetail.description_en: If the container image does not have an HEALTHCHECK instruction defined, you should use the --health-cmd parameter at container runtime to check container health.
extraDetail.rationale_en: If the container image you are using does not have a pre-defined HEALTHCHECK instruction, use the --health-cmd parameter to check container health at runtime. Based on the reported health status, remedial actions can be taken if necessary.
extraDetail.audit_en: You should run the command below and ensure that all containers are reporting their health status: docker ps --quiet | xargs docker inspect --format '{{ .Id }}: Health={{ .State.Health.Status }}'
extraDetail.remediation_en: You should run the container using the --health-cmd parameter. For example: docker run -d --health-cmd='stat /etc/passwd || exit 1' nginx
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, health checks are not carried out at container runtime.

detail_zh: 启用镜像漏洞扫描

detail_zh: 通用配置

detail_en: Enable user namespace support (Automated)
detail_zh: 启用用户名称空间支持（自动）

extraDetail.description: 您应该在Docker守护进程中启用用户名称空间支持，以利用容器用户到主机用户的重映射。当您使用的容器没有在容器镜像中定义显式的容器用户时，此建议是有益的。如果您正在使用的容器镜像具有预定义的非根用户，则可以跳过此建议，因为该特性仍处于初级阶段，并且可能会导致不可预测的问题或配置困难
extraDetail.rationale:
Docker守护进程中的Linux内核“user namespace”支持为Docker主机系统提供了额外的安全性。它允许容器具有唯一的用户和组id范围，这超出了主机系统所使用的传统用户和组范围。
例如，root用户可以在容器内拥有预期的管理特权，但可以有效地将其映射到主机系统上的无特权UID
extraDetail.audit:
docker inspect --format='{{ .State.Pid }}' $(docker ps -q) | while read -r line; do ps -h -p "$line" -o pid,user; done
上面的命令将找到容器的PID，然后列出关联的主机用户使用容器过程。如果容器进程以root身份运行，则此配置可能不符合组织的安全策略。
或者，你可以运行docker info来确保userns列在Security Options下面:
docker info --format '{{ .SecurityOptions }}'
extraDetail.remediation:
请参考Docker文档，了解根据您的需求可以配置的各种方法。您的步骤也可能因平台的不同而有所不同——例如，在Red Hat上，子uid和子gid映射创建不会自动工作。您可能需要创建自己的映射。
高层步骤如下:
步骤1:确保/etc/subuid和/etc/subgid文件存在
touch /etc/subuid /etc/subgid
步骤2:使用——users -remap标志启动docker守护进程
dockerd --userns-remap=default
extraDetail.impact: 用户名称空间重映射与许多Docker特性不兼容，目前还破坏了它的一些功能。详细信息请参考Docker文档和包含的链接
extraDetail.defaultValue: 默认情况下，不重新映射用户名称空间。应该考虑根据所使用的应用程序的需求和组织的安全策略来实现这一点
extraDetail.description_en: You should enable user namespace support in Docker daemon to utilize container user to host user re-mapping. This recommendation is beneficial where the containers you are using do not have an explicit container user defined in the container image. If the container images that you are using have a pre-defined non-root user, this recommendation may be skipped as this feature is still in its infancy, and might result in unpredictable issues or difficulty in configuration.
extraDetail.rationale_en: The Linux kernel "user namespace" support within the Docker daemon provides additional security for the Docker host system. It allows a container to have a unique range of user and group IDs which are outside the traditional user and group range utilized by the host system. For example, the root user can have the expected administrative privileges inside the container but can effectively be mapped to an unprivileged UID on the host system.
extraDetail.audit_en: docker inspect --format='{{ .State.Pid }}' $(docker ps -q) | while read -r line; do ps -h -p "$line" -o pid,user; done The above command will find the PID of the container and then list the host user associated with the container process. If the container process is running as root, then this configuration may be non-compliant with your organization's security policy. Alternatively, you can run docker info to ensure that the userns is listed under Security Options: docker info --format '{{ .SecurityOptions }}'  72 | Page
extraDetail.remediation_en: Please consult the Docker documentation for various ways in which this can be configured depending upon your requirements. Your steps might also vary based on platform - For example, on Red Hat, sub-UIDs and sub-GIDs mapping creation do not work automatically. You might have to create your own mapping. The high-level steps are as below: Step 1: Ensure that the files /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid exist. touch /etc/subuid /etc/subgid  Step 2: Start the docker daemon with --userns-remap flag dockerd --userns-remap=default
extraDetail.impact_en: User namespace remapping is incompatible with a number of Docker features and also currently breaks some of its functionalities. Reference the Docker documentation and included links for details.
extraDetail.defaultValue_en: By default, user namespace is not remapped. Consideration should be given to implementing this in line with the requirements of the applications being used and the organization's security policy.
